articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Models for Identifying Malicious URLs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Malicious URLs, posing threats such as phishing and malware, cause significant financial losses globally. Detecting these URLs automatically before users access them is essential for cyber security. This study explores various machine learning techniques to accurately identify malicious URLs. Decision trees, random forests, K-nearest neighbors (KNN), and naive Bayes models are assessed using a dataset containing over 700,000 URLs. Ensemble models like random forest and extra trees exhibit superior performance, achieving over 93% accuracy in distinguishing between benign and malicious URLs. However, class imbalance remains a challenge, with minority malicious types often exhibiting lower precision. Comparative analysis highlights the feasibility of employing ensemble machine learning for automated malicious URL detection. With adequate examples and feature engineering, tree-based models can effectively identify threats and bolster cyber defense.

articleTitle: Analyzing Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Across Multiple Classes Using an Enhanced Deep Convolutional Neural Network on Blood Smear
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Bone marrow cancer, commonly referred to as Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL), is marked by the rapid proliferation of immature lymphoid cells. This condition affects both children and adults, standing as the most common type of cancer in children. Recent years have seen considerable advancements in diagnosing and treating ALL. Precise risk assessment and the formulation of an effective treatment plan hinge on a comprehensive diagnostic approach that incorporates clinical, morphological, cytogenetic, and molecular data. Nevertheless, to improve survival rates and the quality of life for individuals battling this aggressive blood cancer, further research and clinical trials are imperative to overcome challenges related to drug resistance, relapse, and long-term side effects. Accordingly, this research introduces a highly optimized deep learning model, specifically a deep optimized convolutional neural network (CNN), for the early detection and classification of ALL. The advanced CNN architecture features five convolutional blocks, including 11 convolutional layers and 4 max pooling layers. The optimization of this deep CNN model involved tuning hyper parameters such as epochs, batch size, and the use of specific optimizers, namely Adam and Adamax. Among these, the model achieved superior performance with the Adam optimizer, demonstrating high levels of accuracy and precision, at 0.93 and 0.91 respectively.

articleTitle: Software-Defined-Storage Performance Testing Using Mininet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Customary capacity the board methods are turning out to be less powerful for dealing with this huge volume of information because of the improvement of server farms and the unforeseen ascent away requirements. By eliminating the capacity control exercises out of the genuine information stockpiling media and placing them in the product layer of a concentrated regulator, Programming Characterized Stockpiling offers an answer for this issue. An insightful programming stack named “programming characterized foundation” may deal with reasonable product equipment. A software engineer known as programming characterized capacity controls information capacity assets without the utilization of real equipment. Making the capacity engineering of a genuine Programming Characterized Stockpiling framework with no reenactment or imitating is an exorbitant and unsafe technique. Subsequently, the framework should be recreated prior to being utilized, in actuality. In this manner, virtualized proving grounds for such frameworks should be reenacted before genuine execution and sending. In this article, we evaluate software-defined storage engineering using the Programming Described Association (PDA) test framework, Mini-net. This framework is designed, assembled, and ready to advance without revisiting the established assembly structure. The core components of Mini-net have been modified to address data distribution challenges in contemporary SD storage and to scale storage capacity appropriately within this simulated environment.

articleTitle: Leveraging ML with XGBoost, CatBoost and LGBoost Classifiers to Optimize Water Quality Assessment and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Water is a key valuable resource for the survival of every living being. Water quality is an important concern at the global level as the pollution level continues to rise. Therefore, there is a need to develop methods to control and classify the water based on impurities present. The Machine Learning (ML) classification approach classifies the labels of the dataset for efficient categorical analysis. The Telangana state water quality dataset is taken for analysis purposes. The water quality is divided into 4 major classes. The three classification models used for this comparative analysis are XGBoost, LGBoost and CatBoost. According to the comparative analysis, the overall accuracy of CatBoost is higher out of all the classifiers used. However, the F1-score for the LGBoost classifier is higher for the water quality of class 1. This classification is essential in making smart decisions about sustainable water resource treatment and for taking action toward use to guarantee the quality of drinking water.

articleTitle: Empowering Digital Resilience: SVM Kernel Comparison for Malware Classification to Enhance Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Malware is a software design built specifically to infiltrate the digital system, breach the security of the device and have increased potential to cause serious damage to individual and organizational data. As a result, it is crucial to integrate the ML technological capabilities to detect the malware and categorize them into benign and suspicious. The ML-supervised classification approach utilizes the labels linked to the various parameters to categorize the application as Benign and Suspicious. For the categorical analysis, the SVM algorithm is used and the comparison of the three different SVM kernels: Linear, Polynomial and Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel is done based on performance evaluation criteria. The best-performing SVM kernel is RBF with an accuracy of 98%. To make a sustainable digital space it is necessary to take necessary steps to safeguard the risk of malware applications.

articleTitle: Boosting ASL Communication with a Convolutional-Bidirectional LSTM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This American Sign Language Model represents an advanced deep learning model framework that employs convolutional, bilateral LSTM, and dense layers to analyze sequential input logically. By considering 58 million factors, the model exposes the substantial learning ability capable of detecting subtle patterns within sequential information. To extract hierarchical features, the convolutional layers are more proficient in supplementing with bidirectional LSTm for complete topical modeling and dense layers for additional modification. Implementing the Adam Optimizer at a learning rate of 1e-3, the model illustrates adaptive learning, which is more critical for optimizing parameter updates during training. Over 20 epochs, the virtual model achieved remarkable performance at a mean loss of 0.0065% and an accuracy of over 99%. Precise testing indicates maximum strong performance and adaption to a wide range of sequential data workloads. The suggested design emerges as a strong tool to improve the potential of deep learning for sequence information processing, making a massive contribution to the continuous evolution of advanced neural network architectures.

articleTitle: Auction Based Dynamic Resource Allocation in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Edge computing has gained significant attention in recent years due to its ability to provide low-latency services and handle the massive data generated by IoT devices. One of the critical challenges in edge computing is efficient resource allocation to meet the dynamic demands of various applications. Traditional resource allocation methods may not be suitable for edge environments due to their distributed and heterogeneous nature. In this paper, we propose an auction-based dynamic resource allocation mechanism for edge computing. The proposed approach leverages auctions to allocate resources dynamically based on real-time demand and availability. Through simulations and analysis, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in optimizing resource utilization and improving overall system performance in edge computing environments.

articleTitle: Activity Identification of Androgen Receptor Ligand Binding Domain Using Voting-Based Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In this work, efforts are made to construct a QSAR-based model, which employs computational methods for the detection of Activities to cut down on animal testing, time, and money in the first stages of medication development. To anticipate the behaviour of those pharmacological molecules that bind to the Androgen Receptor Ligand-Binding-Domain, an effective ensemble learning-based model is created. A methodology based on ensembles is suggested for categorizing activity. The 9442 medicinal compounds in the AR-LBD data set, and having a total of 1444 features, 372 of which are active and 9070 inactive. As a result, our dataset has a huge number of features and is quite unbalanced. After performing feature selection, the Smote algorithm was used to address the class imbalance issue. Our ensemble-based prediction model performs outstandingly in comparison to the legacy model. Performance analysis is shown in terms of accuracy, specificity, precision, F-score, and sensitivity, and the same is shown by the bar chart. Finally. The K-fold is carried out to assess the model's consistency.

articleTitle: Dynamic Spectrum Allocation and Pricing in CR-NAN for Smart Grid Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of smart grids, ensuring efficient and reliable communication through cognitive radio-based neighborhood area networks (CR-NAN) is paramount. This paper introduces an innovative machine learning-based framework for dynamic spectrum allocation and differential pricing in CR-NAN, tailored to enhance smart grid operations. Recognizing the critical challenges of spectrum scarcity, dynamic demand, and the need for efficient resource management, we propose a comprehensive solution leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). These techniques are employed to predict spectrum availability, dynamically allocate spectrum resources, and implement a dynamic pricing model that adjusts to real-time network conditions and demand. Our methodology emphasizes not only the maximization of spectrum utilization but also the optimization of network performance through intelligent pricing strategies and admission control mechanisms. Through extensive simulations, our results demonstrate significant improvements in spectrum efficiency, network throughput, and overall communication reliability for smart grid applications. We evaluate results using spectrum utilization (percentage), network throughput (Bits per second (bps)), and pricing efficiency (percentage).

articleTitle: Music Generation with Long Short-Term Memory Networks from MIDI Data of Classical Music
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The generation of music has long been a challenging problem in the field of artificial intelligence. While rule-based approaches have had some success, recent advances in deep learning and sequence modelling present an opportunity for data-driven music composition. In this work, we leverage long short-term memory (LSTM) networks to generate new melodies based on a corpus of MIDI files. Our approach begins by extracting all note events from a datasets of MIDI files to form a corpus of musical sequences. We pre-processes this data by converting notes to a normalized representation and creating an encoded vocabulary of unique note events. An LSTM language model is then trained on these sequences for 200 epochs to learn the statistical patterns and dependencies present in the music corpus. At generation time, the model is seeded with a priming sequence and samples the next note event conditioned on the previous events. This process iterates autoregressively to generate a new melody reflecting the learned musical styles and patterns. We evaluate our generated melodies both quantitatively, in terms of held-out likelihood, and qualitatively through human listening studies. Our results demonstrate that LSTMs can effectively capture long-range dependencies in musical sequences to produce coherent and pleasing melodies resembling the original data distribution. We discuss strengths, limitations, and future directions for this promising approach to data-driven music generation.

articleTitle: Electric Line Fault Detection and Power Consumption Monitoring with Hypertext Preprocessor Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: India has had to deal with issues related to insufficient power generation, distribution, and supply over the years. Concern over the widespread occurrence of electricity theft in the nation is growing. This type of fraud can take many forms, including unauthorized connections, meter tampering, unpaid bills, and irregular billing. Financial statistics show that power theft accounts for the majority of electricity theft. Meter manipulation and magnetic locking are impossible with contemporary electronic meters. As a result, connecting straight from the distribution lines is currently the most popular method of power theft. All power companies deal with the issue of dishonest electricity consumers. In recent years, there has been a lot of activity in the research domain to find effective metrics for identifying fraudulent electricity usage. The goal of this research is to identify instances of unreported power usage and highlight strategies for preventing power theft. Modern communities depend on the efficient and dependable delivery of electricity, therefore utilities make significant investments in the upkeep and security of their transmission and distribution networks. Nonetheless, chronic problems with load management and power theft compromise the reliability of these networks and obstruct the just distribution of electricity. This study presents a comprehensive solution for power monitoring and power theft which is a major global threat for utility companies. There are significant financial losses associated with illegal actions including cutting electricity, tampering with power lines, and adjusting meters.

articleTitle: AI Based Smart Hydroponics System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The AI-Based Smart Hydroponics System seeks to improve hydroponic farming productivity by using artificial intelligence (AI) with Internet of Things (IoT) technology. In this paper an automate intelligent hydroponics system using a range of sensors and machine learning techniques. A regulated container environment is used to develop plants. The system constantly analyses sensor data and modifies settings. Real-time sensors in the system include Humidity and temperature measurements. Ultrasonic Sensors on the container's indicates water level and pH sensors to make sure nutrition solutions are at the right ph. The most recent sensor readings from the server, track the condition of diseases and plant health. This system in automated mode incorporates nutritional modifications to maximise the productivity in real-time scenarios. Disease prevention, water circulation, and nutrition supplementation are some of the actions initiated by the system. In conclusion, the AI-Based Smart Hydroponics System integrates state-of-the-art technology to transform agriculture to optimise resource use and raise crop output.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Implementation of OFDM Using GNU Radio with HackRF One and RTL-SDR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Modern communication systems frequently employ orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) as a modulation technology because of its capacity to reduce the impacts of inter-symbol interference and multipath fading. In this work, the implementation of OFDM using GNU Radio with the HackRF One software-defined radio (SDR) platform has been proposed. The work aims to demonstrate the practical implementation of OFDM, a complex digital communication technique, using readily available hardware and open-source software tools. GNU Radio provides a flexible and powerful framework for signal processing and modulation, while the HackRF One SDR offers the capability to transmit and receive RF signals over a wide frequency range. The implementation involves designing and configuring OFDM transmitter and receiver blocks within the GNU Radio environment, utilizing the HackRF One for RF signal transmission and RTL-SDR for reception. Various aspects such as synchronization, channel estimation, and error correction will be addressed to ensure reliable communication performance. The work not only serves as an educational resource for understanding OFDM principles and GNU Radio usage but also provides a practical platform for experimenting with SDR technology in real-world communication scenarios. OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) signal transmission has been successfully implemented to accommodate three distinct types of input data: textual, audio, and image inputs and their corresponding waveforms and outputs have been obtained.

articleTitle: Design of Solar-Piezoelectric Hybrid Energy Harvesting System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The foot power of human being is generally waste power. The electricity can be generated by using this foot step power. Further, the use of renewable resources particularly by solar PV panels has been increasing in recent years. This is due to their easy availability and low cost. The proposed work showcases utilization of the kinetic energy from people walking on a footboard and solar energy. A PV solar panel is used to harness the solar power. The energy received from this PV panel is utilized to charge a battery. The power generated from the solar panel is detected through Atemga microcontroller and displayed on the LCD. Further, the power is generated by footsteps on a piezo footboard and displayed on the LCD. The display includes the footstep count and the voltage produced per footstep also. Thus, the proposed system facilitates the hybrid battery charging using both solar and footstep energies. Moreover, it enables accurate monitoring of power generated.

articleTitle: Design & Development of IOT based Smart Energy Meter for Energy Conservation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Over time, the need for power has grown dramatically. The reduction of domestic energy consumption is one method for addressing today's energy issues. This has made it more important to use precise and affordable power measurement techniques. In this paper, Arduino is used to create a GSM-based prepaid electricity energy meter. Oneof the finest ideas for the existing power payment system is the prepaid electricity energy meter. Similar to the utilization of cell phones, this technology allows to update the balance and recharge the gadget. This technique can be used to recharge the electricity balance by sending a quick SMS. If the system balance is low or zero, it might also cut off the connection to the home power source.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration of Predictive Maintenance Plans to Improve Operational Efficiency of Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the potential benefits and costs associated with optimizing grid maintenance strategies through the integration of predictive maintenance. The increasing complexity and aging infrastructure of electrical grids necessitate innovative approaches to enhance maintenance efficiency and reliability. Leveraging edge computing technologies enables the processing of data closer to its source, facilitating real-time analysis of grid health metrics and predictive maintenance interventions. By integrating remote smart sensors and cutting-edge edge computing technologies, predictive maintenance offers continuous monitoring capabilities, preempting costly downtime and repairs while enhancing operational efficiency and reliability. This paper performs a thorough cost-benefit analysis that includes initial investment costs, operational expenses, potential savings from predictive maintenance, and the overall impact on grid reliability and performance. Grid operators and policymakers can use valuable insights for assessing the feasibility and value proposition of implementing optimized predictive grid maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Prediction with Fertilizer Recommendation Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Agricultural productivity has a critical role in maintaining economies, especially in nations where a significant proportion of the population is engaged in farming. Plant diseases are a serious risk to agricultural productivity because they can result in losses that are both quantitative and qualitative. To identify plant illnesses, this study suggests a complete system that makes use of deep learning and image processing methods, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).mAn artifi-cial neural network with specific capabilities for processing grid-structured data-especially images-is called a convolutional neural network (CNN). CNNs are particularly good at extracting hierarchical features from visual input. They are made up of pooling layers for spatial dimension reduction, activation functions for adding nonlinearity, and convolutional layers that apply filters to extract local patterns.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Kidney Disease Diagnosis: A Comprehensive CNN-Based Framework for Multi-Class CT Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: A major global health concern, kidney infections are linked to rising death rates, especially when they worsen and cause the breakdown of the kidneys. Kidney function is seriously threatened by common kidney disorders such as nephrolithiasis, kidney tumors, and cyst development. Kidney failure, which can be brought on by conditions including tumors, stones, and cysts, can be avoided with prompt diagnosis and treatment. Computer-aided diagnostics are essential due to the rising incidence of chronic renal illness, the lack of specialists, and the increased need for evaluation and monitoring. Though artificial intelligence (AI) methods, such as machine and deep learning, have been investigated for the identification of renal illness, their effectiveness is still lacking. In order to fill this gap, this study implements a deep learning-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for kidney illness prognosis and classification using a benchmark kidney dataset from Computed Tomography. CNN uses data reprocessing to extract features from the CT images. The results show how effective the suggested method is in correctly classifying renal illness, with a noteworthy accuracy of 99.88%, precision of 99.8%, recall of 99.7%, and an F1-score of 0.98. This work represents a potential development in the field of computer-assisted renal health diagnostics by supporting the use of the refined CNN model as a trustworthy instrument for kidney illness identification. This research can be applied in the medical field for the diagnosis of kidney diseases.

articleTitle: Solar Radiation Prediction: A Comprehensive Analysis of Machine Learning Models and Interpretability Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Solar energy is an imminent renewable energy resources. Solar radiation is one of the important factors of solar energy systems. Obtaining sun radiation data for many regions is still difficult due to either absence of solar radiation measuring equipment's or due to their high cost and limited availability. This study contributes to the current machine learning approaches to find out the solar radiation value for given climatic parameters. The main goal of this study is to analyze a high-accuracy solar radiation forecasting model using regression based models as Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Neural Network Autoregressive with Exogenous Input (NNARX), XgBoost, Multilayer perceptron (MLP) and AdaBoost. The results are evaluated using MAE, MSE, R2 and RMSE. Based on the evaluation metrics the best performing algorithm for this study is XgBoost. The results are interpreted here for each algorithms based on explainable AI - LIME (Local Interpretable Model agnostic Explanations). Additionally, time series analysis was done for this study to have a better understanding of the solar radiation pattern over time.

Author Keywords: Neural Network Autoregressive with Exogenous Input (NNARX)

articleTitle: MahitiBandhu: A Solar-Powered Information Kiosk System for Rural Community Empowerment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: A major portion of Karnataka's population lives in rural areas. Most of the rural people are illiterate and poor due to lack of proper services and infrastructure. There are various rural development schemes run by the government of Karnataka/India for the benefit of villagers. However, most people in the villages of Karnataka are unaware of these schemes due to lack of education, poverty, inaccessibility, and lack of technological knowledge. Hence, the government is trying to render services and information to the public using ICT tools. While there are few examples of achievements of ICT in rural development, there are many failures due to lack of connectivity, bandwidth, language problems, and power supply. Also, Gram Panchayat of the village does not have proper facilities to give widespread publicity about government services and many people do not have smartphones to access information online. Thus, this paper focuses on the development of a solar-powered interactive touch-screen based kiosk system for the rural region. This single system can provide information about all rural schemes for education, agriculture, healthcare, and employment. It also gives information on other services like banking, vaccination drives, and fertilizers for farmers. This is an end-to-end user application with a text-free user interface and interacts based on audio, video, and image display irrespective of the user's literacy level.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Knee Osteoarthritis Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent degenerative joint disorder that has a substantial worldwide ramification, especially among the geriatric population. It is distinguished by the gradual deterioration of cartilage in the knee joint, resulting in manifestations such as stiffness, discomfort, and diminished range of motion. Knee OA, as reported by the World Health Organization, is positioned within the leading ten causes of disability in developed nations. Classification and early detection of knee OA are essential for its effective management. Standard diagnostic techniques, including radiography and clinical examinations, are susceptible to subjectivity and may fail to identify OA in its early stages. In response, a novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method for knee OA classification is introduced in this study. The CNN model is designed to derive detailed features from knee joint images using a dataset of 8381 images from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI), that is divided into training (5923 images) and testing (2458 images) sets. As evidenced by evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, the model effectively classifies different phases of knee OA. This strategy exhibits potential in enhancing clinical decision-making and tailoring treatment regimens for patients diagnosed with knee osteoarthritis.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Detection in ECG Images Using CNN-BiLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Heart and blood vessel diseases are referred to as cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Diagnosing heart disease is a difficult process that can identify a patient's heart condition and enable more effective treatment. The early and accurate detection of Cardiovascular Diseases plays a vital role in reducing morbidity and mortality rates. Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is commonly detected with electrocardiograms (ECGs). Electrocardiogram (ECG) images provide essential information about the electrical activity of the heart, offering valuable insights for diagnosing various cardiac conditions. CNN is frequently used in the medical field, and prompt identification of ECG abnormalities can be crucial to patient care. In recent years, CNN models have shown remarkable capabilities in medical image analysis. A Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) is a kind of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture that enhances the capabilities of traditional LSTMs (Long Short-Term Memory networks) which handles input sequences going both forward and backward. This model proposes a novel CNN-BiLSTM method for ECG image-based cardiovascular disease detection. XGBoost proved to be the most accurate algorithm, with 92% accuracy.

articleTitle: Combining CNN and VGG16: A Novel Deep Learning Approach to Onion Purple Blotch Disease Severity Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The timely and rationally reliable differentiation of plants by diseases from the perspective of fine agriculture is the most critical element, affecting crop yields and therefore global food security to a very large extent. The proposed research paper will present a stand-alone model that is purely based on 2-dimensional imaging, in which convolutional neural network (CNN)architecture is combined with the VGG16 architecture to classify onion purple blotch disease from five different levels. Combining the advantages of VGG16 and in-depth custom CNN layers for a better and more comprehensive solution will ensure the model's scalable and efficient ability for the early detection and severity classification of this common disease. During stringent training on an exhaustive data set of onion leaf images, annotated to represent different levels of disease severity, the model acquired exceptional classification predicaments. It showed 97.14% overall accuracy with which it made a distinction between phases of the disease. Beyond that, the research not only provides a pathway for automated disease detection in agriculture but also illustrates the possibility of successful applications of a hybrid deep learning model in the process of reduction of the risks stemming from diseases which is one of the aspects of the support for sustainable agricultural practices. The development of future research directions features expansion of the model to application in a wider range of crops and diseases, which are extremely important for coming up with more effective and encompassing precision agriculture advances.

articleTitle: DcGAN and EfficientNetB3 Based Analysis and Detection of Alzheimer Detection Using MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline are among the physiological changes brought on by ongoing stress in daily life. AD is the most prevalent kind of dementia in the elderly and is typified by a progressive loss of memory, confusion, and diminished language and cognitive abilities. The suggested technique combines an EfficientNetB3 model with a Deep Convolutional GAN (DcGAN) in a multi-stage manner. 1,125 labeled samples covering various stages of AD are included in the dataset, which was obtained from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) on Kaggle. To overcome data shortage issues, synthetic pictures are produced with the DcGAN. The EfficientNetB3 framework is subsequently adjusted for AD classification by integrating these artificial pictures with the actual ADNI dataset. The model is assessed using performance measures including accuracy, recall, F1-score, precision, and validation accuracy. 90% accuracy is shown overall in the testing findings, with noteworthy recall and precision measures for the non-demented group. The validation stage's superior accuracy of 93.70% and the testing phase's excellent accuracy of 90.27% demonstrate the model's outstanding generalization capabilities. The thorough outcomes demonstrate the model's ability to solve problems with data shortage by highlighting its competence in both generating and classification tasks. A viable approach to enhancing AD classification with possible diagnostic applications is the use of synthetic pictures in the classification pipeline. This paper concludes by outlining the prospects for furthering clinical procedures and research on AD in the future.

articleTitle: Personalized E-commerce: Enhancing Customer Experience through Machine Learning-driven Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, the proliferation of e-commerce platforms has completely transformed how consumers interact with products and services. Amidst this shift, personalization has become a crucial strategy for creating tailored and engaging shopping experiences. This research paper explores the world of personalized e-commerce, investigating how machine learning techniques are utilized to cater to individual customer preferences, enhance conversions, and foster customer loyalty. Through an in-depth review of scholarly literature and case studies, this paper delves into the role of machine learning algorithms in analyzing vast amounts of user data, including browsing history, purchasing behavior, and demographic information. These algorithms are leveraged to deliver personalized product recommendations, dynamic pricing strategies, and curated content. Additionally, the paper examines the ethical considerations surrounding data privacy, transparency, and the potential for algorithmic bias in personalized recommendations. By analyzing successful implementation strategies and the challenges faced by e-commerce businesses, this research provides valuable insights into the potential of machine learning-driven personalization to revolutionize the e-commerce landscape. The findings offer practical recommendations for businesses aiming to strike a balance between delivering tailored experiences and maintaining consumer trust, ultimately fostering sustainable growth in the highly competitive e-commerce market.

articleTitle: Innovations in Skin Diagnostic Technologies: Utilizing a DenseNet201 Deep Learning Model for the Early Detection of Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research work introduces a methodology based on the DenseNet201 Convolutional Neural Network for the timely identification of skin cancer, employing a dataset sourced from the ISIC Archive that comprises 1800 benign and 1497 malignant mole images. Recognizing the crucial role of visual diagnosis in skin cancer identification, the study aims to contribute to automated classification through the implementation of a deep learning model. The 14-step methodology encompasses key procedures such as data loading, categorical labeling, normalization, and model construction using Keras with TensorFlow backend access. The dataset's balanced composition facilitates accurate evaluation, resulting in an impressive accuracy and precision score of 92.7%. The research underscores the significance of early detection in skin cancer and highlights the practical utility of the developed model. Additionally, the paper explores the integration of the ResNet50 architecture, further enhancing the model's performance. This comprehensive approach showcases the efficacy of DenseNet201 in visually categorizing skin lesions and emphasizes the potential of automated systems to assist in timely and precise skin cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: An IoT-Enabled Real-Time Smart Agriculture Monitoring and Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the recent past, due to substantial growth in human population and uncertain environmental conditions worldwide, most of the countries have initiated the new technologies in agriculture field to increase the productivity. Thus, to meet the food requirements, in this paper, an Internet of Things (IoT) enabled real time smart agriculture monitoring and intrusion detection system for crop protection is presented. Initially, the proposed system, enables the farmers to monitor their agriculture field information like, soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and crop health in real-time via a sensor network. ESP32, a micro controller is used to collect these parameters and stores the data in the cloud via a Wi-Fi module. Further, using Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) module, an alert will be sent to farm owner for any abnormalities in the soil, thus improves crop yield. In addition, the proposed model has accurate security management system using a low cost and low power Passive Infrared (PIR) sensor that allows farmers to protect the crop by detecting the intruders (birds and animals) from disturbing and feeding on growing crops. An alert will be sent to farm owner about any malicious activity by intruders using GSM module. Therefore, the proposed IoT model allows farmers to control the irrigation process automatically and reduces the additional operational cost against environmental impact. The performance of the proposed model is illustrated in the form of humidity, temperature, and soil moisture graphs which are displayed on the ThingSpeak platform in real-time mode.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Non-Invasive Data Acquisition System for Diabetic Detection with IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease that affects over 100 million people just in India and it's a severe challenge for Youngsters & Senior citizens. So, early detection of diabetes is crucial to prevent complications and improve patient outcomes. So, to eradicate it, low cost and fast prediction of diabetes is important. This paper we present a low-cost, non-invasive data acquisition system for diabetic detection using the Internet of Things (IoT). Our system utilizes a range of non-invasive sensors to collect physiological data from patients, including body temperature, SP02 level, and heart rate. This data is transmitted to a cloud platform called Thingspeak using a microcontroller (MCU) ESP32. The data collected from diabetic patient is used to create a dataset which can be used for analysis and training of advanced machine learning algorithms. The non-invasive nature of our system makes it user-friendly and accessible, allowing patients to monitor their health from the comfort of their own homes without the need for invasive devices that already exist in the market. Our results demonstrate the potential of our system for improving diabetic detection and management, providing a cost-effective and non-invasive solution for patients and healthcare providers.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture by Leveraging AI and IoT for Intelligent Insect Identification and Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Agriculture is also a significant part of the economy as it forms the basis of the economic system for most developing nations. India is among. There are several major players in the global agricultural industry. Even though there are numerous advanced technologies used in agriculture, no efficient technology has been developed to manage the pestrelated problems. The use of pesticides to control pests in agriculture is an issue that affects countries across the globe. To address this issue, an AI-powered pest detection system has been developed. The aim of this model is to elaborate on. Using an artificial neural network, the acoustic approaches in pest detection are as effective as in classification. The system that we are proposing is a process for recognizing species and damaged leaves that are endangered in farming environments to provide immediate notifications to farmers and protect crops in fields through the integration of a cloud-based warning alert system. Using an Internet of Things (IoT) device with an embedded camera, this project chooses daily photos at random from the crop field and neighboring areas. After that, it will utilize computer vision algorithms and contemporary machine learning techniques to interpret those images. Additionally, it will notify the farmer by sending a message about the insect and damaged leaves it has spotted and recommends a course of action.

articleTitle: Predicting Aircraft Turbofan Engine Degradation with Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Machine learning and deep learning models can be developed to forecast the possibility of a particular outcome in a phenomenon with the help of available data. The paper tackles the problem of predicting the Remaining Useful Life of Aircraft Turbofan engine. The paper's goal is to use machine learning to estimate remaining useful life, or RUL. RUL is the amount of time that a component has left to operate satisfactorily before failing. The model needs to be thoroughly validated using Prognostics metrics and provide forecast uncertainty. When using Remaining Useful Life in conjunction with Predictive Maintenance processes, a machine can be kept dependable and efficient while experiencing less downtime and operational expenses. RNNs are a type of artificial neural network (ANN) that are well-suited for sequential data, such as sensor data from aircraft engines. RNNs are able to learn from the temporal dependencies in the data, which can help to improve the accuracy of RUL predictions. Several different RNN architectures have been used for RUL prediction, including long short-term memory (LSTM) networks and gated recurrent units (GRUs). LSTM networks are particularly wellsuited for tasks that require long-term memory, while GRUs are simpler and more efficient to train. In recent years, RNNs have been combined with other machine learning techniques, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and attention mechanisms, to further improve RUL prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Quaternary Inverter Implemented Using FinFET Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Due to their improved energy economy and reduced circuit complexity, multivalue logics have shown to be beneficial in the field of digital system design. In the field of multivalue logic, quaternary logic is typically regarded as an inventive method. This article describes the design of a quaternary inverter using 18 nm FinFET technology. Further, the performance of quaternary inverter is examined by employing different FinFET models. Based on simulation outcomes, the LVT, SVT, and HVT FinFET models display power consumption values of 8.61, 4.80, and 4.98 µ W, transient delay values of 10.02, 10.08, and 10.29 ns, and power delay product values of 86.33,48.38, and 51.24 (X10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> J), respectively. The designed quaternary inverter architecture is beneficial in designing quaternary arithmetic circuits for applications that requires quaternary signals.

articleTitle: Fall Detection and Safety Accessory Monitoring System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In industrial atmosphere, fall detection and safety accessory monitoring systems are crucial for automating tasks and enhancing worker safety by ensuring proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) use. Traditional methods involve streaming video data to centralized cloud-based systems for PPE monitoring, but this relies heavily on bandwidth and is vulnerable to network outages. Utilizing deep learning techniques like the YOLO algorithm with 95% accuracy, the system detects falls and monitors PPE adherence. Four YOLO algorithm versions are compared based on performance metrics. The model, trained on Google Co-laboratory, is deployed on a Raspberry Pi for onsite implementation, providing reliable notifications and fostering a secure work environment.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID Controller Design for Enhanced Voltage Regulation in Automatic Voltage Regulator System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive investigation into the application of a fuzzy proportional-integral-derivative (FPID) controller for improving voltage regulation in automatic voltage regulator (AVR) systems. The conventional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) control strategy is augmented with fuzzy logic (FL) to address the challenges associated with nonlinearities, uncertainties, and dynamic variations in power systems. This paper delves into the design process, including the selection of appropriate fuzzy sets, membership functions (MF), and rule base construction. Special emphasis is placed on the tuning of fuzzy parameters to optimize the controller's performance in voltage regulation tasks. Comparative studies are conducted to evaluate the FPID controller against traditional PID, simple fuzzy controllers (FCs), and recently published literature to showcase its superior adaptability in scenarios where precise system models are challenging to attain. Simulation results are obtained in MATLAB/SIMULINK to demonstrate the efficacy of the FPID controller in maintaining voltage stability, reducing settling time, overshooting, improving the transient response of the AVR system, and contributing to its robustness in the presence of changing system time constants.

articleTitle: “SynthDefender”: Orchestrating Cyber Resilience with SVM-ANN Union against Reconnaissance Intrusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In order to find vulnerabilities in a system or network, an attacker will do reconnaissance to gather relevant data. Other types of attacks, such as denial-of-service (DoS) and malware insertion, may be planned and carried out using this data. It is critical to find security holes and ensure sensitive data is protected. Innovative methods, including machine learning, may be able to identify and foil these cybercriminals, making the world's IoT networks more trustworthy and secure. In order to detect possible reconnaissance attacks, this research employs a mixed method that combines Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). By integrating ANN for pattern recognition and Support Vector Machines (SVM) for point classification, an effective learning approach is generated. They want to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of Reconnaissance Intruder detection in order to reduce the effect of network attacks. Finding surveillance incursions using data from the CICIoT23 database is the main objective of the research. Algorithms that detect assassination attacks in IoT networks might benefit greatly from this dataset, because of its large and diverse sample size.

articleTitle: EfficientNetB1 Model for Lung Cancer Detection using Biopsy Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Lung cancer, a pervasive and life-threatening ailment, necessitates early and precise diagnosis. This research endeavors to employ Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automate the detection of lung cancer in histopathological biopsy images, addressing challenges associated with timely and accurate diagnosis. Given the error-prone and time-consuming nature of manual assessment by pathologists, an automated approach becomes imperative. The study encompasses a comprehensive scope, including enhancing interpretability, classifying specific lung cancer subtypes, real-time intraoperative analysis, and extending the application to other cancer types. The methodology involves the utilization of a pre-trained Efficient Net-based model for image classification, showcasing its efficacy in discerning between benign and malignant lung cancer cells, as evidenced by robust training results. Moreover, the model exhibits potential for personalization in lung cancer diagnosis and treatment. Research findings affirm that machine learning models, specifically the EfficientNet-based architecture, markedly improve lung cancer detection accuracy. The model's proficiency in subtype differentiation and its capacity for real-time surgical analysis represent significant strides in lung cancer diagnostics and treatment. In conclusion, this project addresses the critical imperative for accurate and timely lung cancer diagnosis, providing a promising advancement in combatting this devastating disease. The developed model holds transformative potential in radiology and oncology, serving as a valuable tool for medical professionals and contributing to enhanced patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Implementing Convolutional Neural Networks and AdaBoost for Varied Turmeric Discrimination in India
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This study looks at how well a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) combined with AdaBoost can classify three main types of turmeric—Rajendra Sonia, Prabha, and Suvarna—in India. Using a carefully picked set of 11,000 high-quality turmeric root pictures, the suggested model did well. It had an excellent overall success rate of 98.2%. The model's success shows how good it is at telling small differences among turmeric types found in different farming areas. Table I shows measurements for performance evaluation. These include precision, recall, and F1-score which all work together well to show the model is good at reducing errors while identifying facts in the best way possible. The confusion matrix gives a big picture of how well the model does in classifying things. It shows correct and wrong guesses for each turmeric type group. This study helps to improve precision farming by offering a reliable system for the automatic classification of turmeric varieties. The shown correctness and good results support how important this model can be for improving farming ways, helping farmers make choices, and making sure the turmeric they sell is of nice quality. This research uses advanced computer methods to make it easier to classify different types of turmeric. It also shows a great example of using modern technology in farming, which could lead to better ways of sorting crops and higher farm output.

articleTitle: Utilization of Fuzzy TOPSIS And Fuzzy AHP Tactics Inside the Choice of Wastewater Treatment Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In order to identify the best wastewater treatment techniques, this research study examines the practical usage of Fuzzy approach for Order of preference with the aid of Similarity to perfect answer (Fuzzy TOPSIS) and Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy technique (Fuzzy AHP) approaches. Within environmental engineering, wastewater treatment is a crucial area that must deal with many requirements and uncertainties. The inherent ambiguity involved in evaluating various treatment options can be addressed by incorporating fuzzy logic into these decision-making systems. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of TOPSIS and AHP in systematically rating and finding the most appropriate wastewater treatment approaches through a thorough assessment of relevant literature, diligent data collecting, and consultation with domain experts. A mathematical framework for evaluating alternatives is provided by fuzzy TOPSIS, and the insertion of numerous criteria and their respective weights is made easier by fuzzy AHP.

articleTitle: Application Strategy Analysis of Multi-Objective Optimization Routing Algorithm in Korean Translation Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's rapid development of high technology, the use of scientific and technological means to make the development of Korean translation software better has made a trend, in order to more adapt to today's development, create intelligent Korean translation software, so that the level of accuracy of Korean translation software is improved, Korean translation software followed. In Korean translation software, it is very important to collect, analyze, and process the information of the living organism in the Korean translation software to achieve the accurate realization of Korean translation software. Neural network algorithms cannot accurately collect and analyze information problems in Korean translation software. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-destination optimization routing algorithm for policy analysis and analysis. First, computer technology is used to collect Internet information, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of strategy analysis to reduce interference factors in strategy analysis. Then, computer technology analyzes the strategy analysis results of Korean translation software, forms a strategy analysis scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the strategy analysis results. MATLAB simulation shows that the strategy analysis accuracy and strategy analysis reliability of the multi-objective optimization routing algorithm for Korean translation software are better than those of the neural network algorithm under certain evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Low Power and High Throughput 12-Tap FIR Filter Using Unfolding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: FIR filters (Finite impulse response) are widely used in VLSI due to their characteristics like linear phase and stability. FIR filter finds its key applications in domains like digital signal processing, communication systems, audio and image processing, control systems and sensor signal processing. The existing filter design takes up more area, requiring more memory and time. The design of higher order filters is also complex and requires even more memory and area. Therefore, in VLSI, FIR filters are often implemented using efficient algorithms and architectures to meet the requirements of low power consumption, high speed, and reduced area. This paper is aimed at designing a 12th order FIR filter using various retiming techniques and algorithms to improve the efficiency, speed, and area. The degree of efficiency of a technique is determined based on the application and a tradeoff between various metrics involved in it. The design is implemented in MATLAB Simulink and HDL code is generated for further analysis. The design is modified during the HDL code analysis if required to meet the user specifications of design metrics like area, speed, and power. In this paper we have implemented the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$12^{\text{th}}$</tex> order direct form, transposed form, cut-set retiming and unfolded forms of the FIR filter designs in MATLAB Simulink then simulated in the Xilinx design suite tool and implemented on the FPGA board. In comparison to the direct form, transposed form and cut-set retiming form, the 3-unfolded form of FIR filter design have the high area of 24138 LTU's, more power of 107mW and lower delay of 9.451ns as it involves the addition of registers or delay elements. From the results, we can observe that the proposed techniques are proven to be better than the conventional design in terms of performance like speed, delay, power, and area.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Speech Emotion Recognition using Multiple Acoustic Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Automatic speech emotion recognition (ASER) is crucial for multiple robotics applications, social media platforms, human-machine interaction systems, auto-chatbots, etc. However, the ASER performance is poor due to inadequate representation of the emotional speech, poor feature distinctiveness, and less generalization capability. This paper presents ASER based on a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) that accepts the multiple acoustic features (MAF) to describe emotional speech. Further, it uses a combination of hybrid particle swarm optimization and Archimedes optimization algorithm (PSO-AOA) for selecting the essential features from MAFs. The outcomes of the MAF-PSO-AOA-DCNN are assessed on the BAUM dataset. It provides an overall accuracy of 95.20%, precision of 0.96, recall of 0.94, and F1-score of 0.95, which is superior to traditional techniques.

articleTitle: Development of a Fast and Energy-Efficient Carrier Bypass Adder with Tunable Delay Extension Using the Han Carlson Adder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel Developing a fast, energy-efficient carry skip adder with configurable delay extension utilizing the Han Carlson adder, leveraging Han Carlson adder algorithm. Traditional carry skip adders are renowned for their ability to mitigate propagation delays associated with carry signals in conventional adders [1]. The Han Carlson adder further refines this approach, improving efficiency. Moreover, the inclusion of a variable latency extension empowers the adder to dynamically adjust its operating speed to suit varying computational requirements. The primary objective of this design is to strike a balance between speed and energy efficiency, rendering it applicable across a broad spectrum of applications [2]. The paper meticulously presents and analyzes the design and implementation details of this advanced architecture. Experimental results underscore its superior performance compared to existing adder architectures, validating its efficacy and potential impact on diverse computational domains.

articleTitle: Automated Video Quality Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Video streaming is a common service utilized in today's times, ranging from popular platforms such as Netflix, Disney, and Amazon Prime to live video calls facilitated by WhatsApp and FaceTime. Given the growing computational capabilities and the imperative of delivering optimal end-user experiences, there arises a necessity to develop methods for testing and analyzing the video quality of streaming content. In our research, we propose a method for analyzing the same as well as a substantial publicly available dataset comprising thousands of distorted frames. We employ a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to train a model for discerning whether a frame in a video input is glitched or not, addressing the imperative of ensuring seamless video playback and enhanced user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Digital Sensor Forecasting for Metro Air Units: A Vector Autoregression Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Forecasting data for maintenance is crucial for companies to prevent system failures and accidents by identifying and classifying failures in a timely manner. In this research, we used vector autoregression to forecast values of sensor data. Which will in turn be useful for predictive maintenance and anomaly detection. The proposed method relies on the digital sensor data of the MetroPT dataset. The proposed framework forecasts the values of the sensor readings this allows management to predict maintenance requirements by forecasting sensor readings, enabling them to address system failures before they escalate into serious issues, thus boosting vehicle reliability and reducing metro network downtime. Most of the transport and solutions in India rely on railways and metro vehicles, it is difficult to manually check numerous small components. Therefore, it is crucial to monitor the sensor data and further use it in predictive maintenance and anomaly detection. By using this approach, operational processes can run more smoothly, and the likelihood of unexpected incidents and uncertainties can be decreased.

articleTitle: Digital Remodeling and Application of Ceramic Cultural Heritage Based on Characteristic Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The role of digital technology in the reshaping of intangible cultural heritage ceramic cultural and creative products is very important, but there is a problem that the characteristics of intangible cultural heritage elements are not obvious. The traditional design method cannot solve the problem that the characteristics of intangible cultural heritage ceramics cultural and creative products and reshaped intangible cultural heritage elements are not obvious, and it is handled Unreasonable. Therefore, a feature clustering algorithm is proposed to perform feature clustering analysis of intangible cultural heritage elements. Firstly, the cluster analysis theory is used to extract the features of the ceramic remodeling data, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of feature clustering processing to reduce them Interference factors in digital technology. Then, the cluster analysis theory analyzes the characteristics of intangible cultural heritage ceramics, forms a feature clustering processing scheme, and analyzes the digital technology The results were comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain processing standards, the feature clustering algorithm has an accurate effect on the analysis of ceramic reshaping feature clustering. The digitization time is better than traditional design methods.

Author Keywords: The characteristics of intangible cultural heritage elements are not obvious

articleTitle: Dynamic Path Planning of the Robotic Surgical Needle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Robotics surgery is fast becoming ubiquitous in medical practices from cancer treatment to prostrate treatment to neurological problems. One of the major problem associated with this invasive surgery is how to minimize the loss of the adjacent tissues and accuracy of the reaching the target. In the present paper we have presented our work related to bevel tip surgical flexible needle supported by multi degree of freedom robot. We have modelled the mathematical equation and solved it using evolutionary optimization technique, Firefly Algorithm. Our aim is to minimize the losses to the adjacent tissues with high accuracy of reaching target. From the robot a probe and robotic needle is attached that traversed the curvilinear path. Probabilistic random tree method based method is applied to reach the lesion starting from hole in the skill. Initial and final point, target, is feed as a target. The constrained with risk map is defined that must be avoided to minimizing the loss of the sensitive organs. Finally the whole problem is reduced to optimization problem with given constant. A gelatin based material is used to mimic the brain tissue with the help of this indentation by needle is shown to find the optimized path.

articleTitle: Impact of Device Parametrics on a 10nm Gate Length SOI n-FinFET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the behaviour of a Tri-gate Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) n-FinFET with a gate length of 10nm. Innovative gate stacking featuring SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> oxide layer, and a ferroelectric film along with a TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> spacer are two features of the device that improve performance in low-power applications. Utilizing TCAD models, the research delves into crucial subthreshold variables, including threshold voltage and subthreshold swing and other output parameters like the drain induced barrier lowering (DIBL) which are analysed using Silvaco simulations. Systematic investigation of the effects of the incorporating TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> spacer and gate stacking found the subthreshold swing value of the optimised FinFET design to be 136 mV/dec and the DIBL value for the optimised design is found to be 63.10 mV/V. Changes in the I-on and I-off values for the optimised design are also observed. The effects of the variation of the gate metal work function <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\Phi_{\mathrm{m}})$</tex> are also studied. Our research helps to better comprehend unique design configurations for sub-10nm FinFETs, to continue advancing semiconductor technology and create more effective integrated circuits.

articleTitle: An Automated Approach to Petechiae Detection: Advancement in Medical Imaging and Diagnostic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research paper presents an innovative approach to petechiae detection utilizing advanced computer vision algorithms. The study employs the YOLO v8 computer vision algorithm to classify images, distinguishing those containing petechiae from those without. Additionally, the research utilizes the OpenCV (cv2) library in Python to quantify the number of blood clusters within the petechial rash. A threshold value is assigned to determine the severity of the petechial rash based on the identified blood clusters. The proposed methodology showcases a promising automated system for petechiae detection, contributing to the development of efficient diagnostic tools in the field of medical imaging.

articleTitle: An Grid-Integrated Electric Vehicles with Hybrid Energy Storage for Optimal Power Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: As the availability of green energy sources fluctuates, integrating them into existing electrical distribution networks presents issues to electricity quality and sustainability. To address this, a hybrid storage system comprising a battery and supercapacitor, alongside a grid-connected PV system, is proposed. This system aims to enhance efficiency by reducing power transients and smoothing average power, thereby enabling swift regulation of DC voltage. By leveraging the battery's state of charge (SOC) to regulate the allocation of power across the grid including the battery system, the stability of the system is enhanced, especially during periods of high demand and variations in solar power. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of this energy management scheme in mitigating strain on the storage system and facilitating the integration of PV power. Additionally, the incorporation of a supercapacitor helps minimize stress and rapid current changes on the storage system, ensuring smoother power distribution and load requirements. Overall, by addressing the issues raised by the incorporation of energy from renewable sources, this integrated strategy promises to improve power distribution networks' stability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Classification of Urban Sound using Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Model and its Visualisation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to classify urban noise using a Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, a robust deep learning framework for processing audio signals. Precise urban sound categorization is crucial for public safety, environmental monitoring, and the advancement of smart cities. By quickly extracting hierarchical components from audio input using a sequential convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, the proposed technique correctly recognises a wide range of urban noises. We are amassing a large collection of urban sounds, which include a diverse range of ambient noises often found in cities, as part of our study. We use the dataset to train the Sequential CNN model. That this model is capable of autonomously learning hierarchical representations of audio data is a major strength. Using previously stated criteria, we test the model's ability to distinguish between various urban sound classes and see how well it performs. To further investigate and comprehend the internal representations learnt by the CNN model, the study also employs visualisation approaches. Visualisation aids in comprehending the model's decision-making process and the features that differentiate different kinds of urban sound. In order to identify which parts of the input spectrogram have a major impact on the model's predictions, heatmaps are created using techniques like gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM). The findings demonstrate the practical usability of the Sequential CNN model, as it effectively classifies urban noises with an accuracy rate of 86%. The visualisation tools boost trust and acceptance in real-world applications by simplifying the model's decision-making process. Thanks to this research, intelligent systems that can assess city sounds have advanced in development. In order to make deep learning models more trustworthy and easier to use, it is necessary to combine interpretability tools with them.

articleTitle: Advancing Intrusion Detection with Machine Learning: Insights from the UNSW-NB15 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research undertakes a comparative examination of the recall performance of Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), and Decision Tree (DT) models for intrusion detection systems (IDS). The analysis is conducted using the UNSW-NB15 dataset, which is a comprehensive compilation of contemporary cyber-attack scenarios. The objective is to assess the effectiveness of these models in their respective roles. According to our investigation, Random Forest has superior performance compared to LR and DT in the detection of network intrusions. It exhibits the greatest recall values, which are of utmost importance in mitigating false negatives in Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). The exceptional efficacy of RF highlights its resilience and versatility in addressing the intricate and diverse array of cyber threats. While LR demonstrated impressive outcomes, particularly when dealing with less complex assault methods, and DT provided simplicity in interpretation, both were somewhat less efficient when compared to RF. The results indicate that Random Forest has great potential for use in modern Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), prompting more investigation into ensemble methods, deep learning, and unsupervised learning approaches to improve threat detection. This work contributes to the progress of machine learning-based security measures and guides the creation of more efficient and adaptable Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) that can effectively address the changing nature of cyber threats.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Typical Models of Rural Electrification Under the Background of Energy Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The exploration and practice of typical models of electrification is critical in rural electrification under the background of energy intelligence, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Big data algorithms is unable to address the typical models of rural issue in rural electrification under the background of energy intelligence, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Internet of thing-based exploration and practice of typical models of rural electrification under the background of energy intelligence is provided, and expectoration and practice of typical models of rural electrification under the background of energy intelligence is assessed. To begin, the sensor network theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the exploration and practice of typical models of electrification's needs to decrease interference factors in the exploration and practice of typical models of electrification. The sensor network theory is then used to create a Internet of thing exploration and practice of typical models of electrification scheme, and the outcomes of the exploration and practice of typical models of electrification are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Internet of thing outperforms the standard Big data algorithms in terms of exploration and practice of typical models of electrification accuracy and time of influencing variables.

Author Keywords: Internet of thing;exploration and practice of typical models of electrification

articleTitle: Dynamic Portfolio Management Using Multi-Model Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The traditional portfolio management approaches tend to rely on static models that struggle to adapt to changing market conditions. This paper deploys a multi-model deep reinforcement learning system to build and manage a portfolio, achieving high-risk adjusted returns over an extended period using current market state inputs. Advantage actor-critic, deep deterministic policy gradient, and proximal policy optimization are the three models used. The three models are validated using the Sharpe ratio for all three models in a three-month rolling window, and use the best-performing model to manage the portfolio for the next three months. The system's risk-adjusted returns exceed those of the benchmark Dow Jones industrial average in both the Sharpe ratio and cumulative return. The proposed system has acquired a Sharpe ratio of 1.45 and a cumulative return of 73 % compared to the benchmark which has got Sharpe ratio of 0.43 and a cumulative return of 40.5%.

articleTitle: Advancing Sustainability in Communication Systems: Design and Analysis of Energy-Efficient Flip-Flop Circuits on FPGA Platforms
