publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: To better understand how to design flip-flop circuits for sustainable communication systems, this research focuses on Field-Programmable Gate Array platforms for testing and implementation. The aim is to lower power consumption while maintaining operational reliability by looking into creative circuit topologies and energy-efficient techniques. The study examines a flip-flop architecture in detail while taking power efficiency, space usage, and performance metrics into account. Functional validation on FPGA boards yields valuable insights into the feasibility and efficacy of the recommended methodologies. This work contributes to the advancement of environmentally friendly communication technology by providing workable solutions for reducing the negative effects on the environment and energy consumption in digital circuitry.

articleTitle: Optimization of Logistics Distribution Path for Improved Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: optimization of logistics distribution routes is critical in intelligent rural low-carbon logistics, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical particle swarm arithmetic is unable to address the path optimization issue in intelligent rural low-carbon logistics, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Improved multi-objective genetic algorithms-based improve the optimization of rural low-carbon logistics distribution route is provided, and improve the optimization of rural low-carbon logistics distribution route is assessed. To begin, the non-dominated ranking theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on optimization of logistics distribution routes's needs to decrease interference factors in optimization of logistics distribution routes. The non dominated ranking theory is then used to create a Improved multi-objective genetic algorithms Logistics distribution route optimization scheme, and the outcomes of optimization of logistics distribution routes are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Improved multi-objective genetic algorithms outperforms the standard particle swarm arithmetic in terms of Logistics distribution route optimization accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Different 2-Stage Dynamic Comparators for Low Power Consumption and High Speed
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The proposed comparator architecture includes various kinds of comparators like dynamic two-stage Conventional Comparator to compare with different designs like 19T Comparator, 28T Comparator is designed and it's simulation results are analyzed in cadence 180nm Technology. During analysis, the parameters like Power and Delay is observed. The 19 Transistor design has power consumption of 92.80uW which is comparatively smaller than conventional and 28 Transistor design having 154.1uW and 103.8uW respectively. Also less delay is observed in 19T Comparator with 176.2ps compared to other transistor designs like conventional dynamic comparator and 28 Transistor comparator designs. Therefore 19 transistor comparator is most power efficient and having more speed in operation.

articleTitle: Unifying RNN and KNN for Enhancing Mirai Attack Detection in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Malicious software gets into Internet of Things (IoT) devices by using exploits and default passwords, which leads to Mirai attacks on IoT networks. These viruses can turn devices into botnets, which raises the risk of major security holes. Massive Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks are then possible, which threatens the security of networks and stops internet services. In This research paper suggests a way to better find Mirai threats in IoT networks by mixing the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) methods. In the proposed model takes the best parts of both RNN and KNN systems and puts them together. The RNN architecture is best at finding time relationships in data about network traffic, while the KNN architecture is best at finding trends. When the authors combined the results of both models into our combined approach, it makes identification more accurate than other methods that are already out there. Empirical studies using a variety of datasets clearly demonstrate that our method regularly and accurately finds Mirai attacks. The Recurrent Neural Network and K-Nearest Neighbors method works better together to protect against new Mirai cyber risks in IoT settings. The integrated RNN and KNN provide the good accuracy with 82% of mirai attack detection. This new development makes a big difference in the field of defense.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach to Design Ternary Logic Circuits with GNRFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This project introduces a novel approach for designing ternary logic circuits using Graphene Nanoribbon Field-Effect Transistors (GNRFETs) and HSPICE software. Emphasizing three states (0, 1, and an intermediate state), ternary logic promises enhanced information processing over binary systems. The study leverages GNRFETs' unique properties, including high carrier mobility, in HSPICE simulations. A systematic approach within HSPICE facilitates custom GNRFET modeling, circuit optimization, and validation of ternary logic gates. Key outcomes emphasize improved computational efficiency, laying the groundwork for future computing advancements. Additionally, the study explores the impact of environmental factors and scaling effects on GNRFET-based ternary circuits, providing insights into their robustness and scalability. Furthermore, the project investigates novel techniques for error tolerance and noise resilience in ternary logic circuits, addressing critical challenges for practical deployment. The comprehensive exploration of GNRFET-based ternary logic signifies a leap in computational capabilities. It sets the stage for innovative applications in emerging technologies, such as neuromorphic computing and advanced data processing paradigms.

articleTitle: Power Regulation Features for Artificial Intelligence Based Optimisation of EV Motor Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: When energy storage is limited, energy efficiency is crucial for hybrid and electric vehicles (EVs). The induction motor's high stability, low cost, and little loss structure boost its efficiency. Furthermore, even at moderate loads, it draws more current then is required for the work at hand. This study proposes an opaque logic control based control technique for EV (FLC) applications. With fewer energy consumption, the FLC controller improves the initial power distribution. The MATLAB/SIMULINK software package is used for simulation to verify the controller's performance. Simulation techniques outperform conventional proportional-integrated- derivative controllers in terms of time-domain reactivity and fast rejection of disruptions connected to the system. This significantly reduces the primary losses of the asynchronous motor, boosting the efficiency of the drive system. The simulation results are used to verify that the proposed control system is in great agreement with them.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity: A Fusion Approach of Artificial Neural Networks and Decision Trees for Robust Imbalanced DDoS Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: An important danger to internet services is DDoS attacks, which try to block access by sending too much data to specific sites. These attacks are able to go undetected because they use flaws in the way the network is set up. Protocol attacks, application-layer attacks, and massive flooding are all types of DDoS attacks that can make systems much harder to reach and less effective. Because online services are becoming more and more popular, controlling the effects of Distributed Denial of Service attacks is still a very important safety problem. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Decision Tree filters are used together in the suggested model to find DDoS attacks. Using this effective strategy, combining two different strategies makes it easier to find things. When Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Decision Tree algorithms are put together, they make a full DDoS detection model. Even though the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) can spot complicated patterns, the Decision Tree makes the decision-making process more clear. Using a thorough method improves the model's general ability to handle and understand problems, making it a powerful tool for stopping DDoS attacks in a variety of network settings.

articleTitle: Dysarthric Speech Recognition Using Deep Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Dysarthric speech recognition (DSR) plays imperative role in assisting vocally impaired people to indulge in voice based automation systems and human computer interaction. DSR is exigent due to low intelligibility of impaired speaker, less dataset availability, low intra-class and inter-class variability in the speech samples. This paper presents DSR based on Deep Convolution Neural Network (DCNN and Mel Frequency Logarithmic Spectrogram (MFLS). The proposed MFLS+DCNN provides superior spectral-temporal representation of the speech signal. The results of the MFLS-DCNN scheme are validated on UASpeech dataset based on accuracy, recall, precision and F1-score. The proposed scheme provides accuracy of 96.83%, recall of 0.97, precision of 0.96, and F1-score of 0.97 which has shown significant improvement over traditional state of arts.

articleTitle: Realtime Guide for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Navigating through the world can be a formidable challenge for visually impaired individuals. This research introduces a real-time guide system leveraging computer vision to enhance the autonomy of the visually impaired. Utilizing the YOLOv4 model, trained on the COCO dataset, the system detects and identifies objects in the surroundings. Users can interact with the system through voice commands, inquiring about the presence of specific objects or receiving directions for navigation. The system will guide them through voice commands for seamless access to visually impaired people as well. The system's architecture encompasses a holistic approach to empower users, offering real-time object detection accuracy metrics and assessing the effectiveness of voice-based interaction in aiding navigation. This research contributes by addressing the limitations of existing assistive technologies, providing a comprehensive solution for real-time guidance. The future trajectory involves further automation of navigation tasks and the exploration of additional sensors for an enriched understanding of the environment. Also, integration of artificial intelligence can further enables automation, allowing users to perform various tasks seamlessly through voice commands. This research strives to significantly impact the lives of visually impaired individuals by fostering independence and accessibility through innovative technological solutions.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of AXI4 Stream Interconnect Using Verilog
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: System-on-a-chip (SoC) designs depend on the Advanced eXtensible Interface (AXI) 4 protocol and essentially AXI4 stream protocol, which enables fast data transfers between multiple master and slaves through interconnect architecture. The development of an AXI 4 Stream protocol interconnect setup with one master and two slave modules, simulated under Verilog HDL, is shown in this work using a unique technique. We optimize the connection architecture for reliable data transfer using round robin algorithm. The findings show that the suggested configuration guarantees reliable data processing and resilience in a multi-slave context in addition to complying with the AXI4 stream protocol criteria.

articleTitle: Binary Classification of Epilepsy Using Classical Machine Learning Algorithms and Ensemble Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures. Seizures are caused by abnormal electrical activity in the brain. Symptoms of epilepsy can vary widely, depending on the type of seizure and the part of the brain affected. Some people with epilepsy may experience only occasional seizures, unconsciousness, and temporary confusion while others may have frequent seizures that are difficult to control. Early detection of Epilepsy is possible through several form of input data, ranging from Video, Audio, Text, several physiological data (such as Heartbeat & Blood pressure) and ECG. In this paper we have used ECG recoding data and several Machine Learning algorithms to detect Epilepsy. In our Experiment, we have used ‘UCI Epileptic Seizure Recognition Dataset’ and to counter the Problem of Imbalance data set we have used SMOTE analysis. We have also done various Hyper parameter tuning processes to improve the overall result of the performance of the model. We have found that the Gradient Tree Boosting Algorithm Has Outperformed K- Nearest Neighbor (K-NN), Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree (D.T.), Random Tree classifiers with 97.41% Accuracy, ROC = 0.974, and RMSE = 0.16.

articleTitle: Sustainable Farming Through IOT-Enhanced Weather Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The limited availability of clean water worldwide has created a need for its efficient use. IoT systems use application-specific sensors to collect data and analyse it intelligently, connecting the cyber and bodily realms. Smart irrigation systems based on IoT may optimise water-resource use in precision agriculture. This study introduces an open-source smart system that utilises ground parameters such as temperature of soil, soil moisture and ambient factors, in combination with weather prediction data from the Internet, to estimate the irrigation needs of a field. The system's intelligence relies on a sophisticated algorithm that takes into account sensory data and weather prediction characteristics such as precipitation, humidity, air temperature and UV levels for the next period. The system has been created and implemented on a small scale for testing purposes. Sensor data is collected wirelessly through the cloud using web services. A web-based system for information visualisation and decision support offers real-time insights by analysing sensor data and weather forecasts. The article outlines the system and provides a detailed analysis of the information processing outcomes from three weeks of data using the suggested algorithm. The system is operating at full capacity and the prediction outcomes are really promising.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Model of University Academic Style Based on Association Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In colleges and universities, the construction of learning style is particularly important, which can create a good learning atmosphere, and excellent learning atmosphere can also make students develop morally, intellectually, physically and aesthetically. The construction of traditional study style cannot solve the problem of building academic style in colleges and universities. Therefore, this paper proposes a correlation analysis algorithm to analyze the construction of learning style. First of all, data mining is used to analyze and evaluate the construction of study style, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of study style construction to reduce it Interference factors in the construction of study style. Then, the data mining the analysis results of the academic style construction of colleges and universities, forming the academic style construction plan, and the results of the academic style construction Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the correlation analysis algorithm has a rational effect on the construction of academic style in colleges and universities. The feasibility of the construction time of the study style is better than that of the traditional study style construction.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Identifying Brain Strokes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Brain stroke, a critical medical condition, requires prompt diagnosis and treatment to minimize its adverse effects. Machine learning techniques have shown promise in aiding the early detection of brain stroke through medical imaging analysis. This study proposes the utilization of two advanced deep learning architectures, namely ResNet and U-Net, for the automated detection and segmentation of brain stroke. ResU-Net, an enhanced version of U-Net used incorporates residual connections to improve information flow and model performance. Leveraging a dataset comprising medical images of stroke-afflicted brains, the proposed models are trained to accurately segment and classify regions indicative of stroke presence. Metrics including accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and Dice coefficient are used to evaluate the models ability to detect the brain damage. The ability of all three layouts in precisely identifying brain stroke locations is demonstrated by experimental data. The U-Net exhibits slightly superior performance over ResNet. Performance of ResU-Net in the proposed approach holds promise for assisting healthcare professionals in early diagnosis and further refinement and validation of these models on larger and diverse datasets enhance their generalizability and clinical utility in real-world settings. Real-time image capture and classification, along with immediate feedback, contribute to its mission of advancing stroke diagnosis and potentially saving lives through AI-driven healthcare improvement.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Creation Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the realm of intelligent music, composition research holds significant importance. However, it faces challenges with imprecise composition positioning. The prevalent bee colony algorithm fails to address this issue effectively in intelligent music composition studies, often yielding unsatisfactory outcomes. This paper introduces an innovative approach to intelligent music composition using a collaborative filtering algorithm and delves into its analysis. Initially, principles of proximity and similarity are employed to pinpoint influential factors, subsequently categorizing indicators to mitigate disruptive elements in composition research. Following this, the same principles aid in formulating a collaborative filtering algorithm-based strategy for composition research, leading to a thorough evaluation of results. MATLAB simulations reveal that when assessed against specific criteria, the collaborative filtering algorithm outperforms the conventional bee colony algorithm in both accuracy of compositional research and time efficiency related to influencing factors.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Simulation Model Based on Intelligent Allocation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer-related technology in China, the application range of computer simulation technology is becoming more and more extensive. As one of the important research methods of computer simulation technology, simulation model has been widely used in various fields. However, traditional allocation algorithms often only address basic needs, and resource allocation is unreasonable. Therefore, an intelligent allocation algorithm is proposed to analyze the simulation model of cross-combination optimization. Firstly, the computer simulation theory is used to analyze the constructed computer simulation model, and the indicators are divided according to the resource allocation requirements to reduce the interference factors in the simulation model. Then, the computer simulation theory intelligently allocates computer resources, forms a resource allocation scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the simulation model results. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain processing technology standards, the intelligent allocation algorithm is better than the traditional allocation algorithm for computer resource allocation accuracy, computer resource utilization efficiency and calculation time.

articleTitle: Design of Tunable Multi-Band Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper represents a novel design of tunable multi-band antenna with motive of applying it in wireless application. The tunable antenna is designed with a dimension of 46.8mm×2.6mm×31.25mm×62.5mm along with FR4(Flame retardant) as substrate with dielectric constant of 4.6 and thickness of 1.6 mm. Frequency tuning technique is utilized to achieve the analogy of tunable antenna. Bowtie antenna with two bowtie elements is responsible for the resonance at 900MHz, 1,61GHz, 2,14GHz, 2,44GHz, 3,57GHz frequencies with the respective gains of 0.67db, 4.58db, 4.14db, 3.79db, 7.29db. Tunable multiband antenna has a return loss less than −10db, SWR ≤ 2 and has a better bandwidth behavior suitable for multi-band application. The proposed antenna could be used for GSM, WLAN, LTE & 5G applications.

articleTitle: A Computer Simulation Study of an Improved Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Aiming at the inefficiency of Apriori algorithm, this paper proposes an improved Apriori algorithm, which is tested and evaluated in combination with computer simulation research. The improved algorithm aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of association rule mining by introducing decision tree strategies and parallel processing methods. This study used multiple datasets for experiments and compared the performance indicators of the improved algorithm with the traditional Apriori algorithm. Firstly, an improved Apriori algorithm is proposed to reduce the number of candidates sets and reduce the time complexity of the algorithm through the decision tree strategy. The parallelization method further improves the efficiency of the algorithm by dividing the data set into subsets and using multiple threads for simultaneous processing. Then, multiple real and integrated datasets are used for experimental evaluation. The results show that the improved algorithm has significantly reduced the running time compared with the traditional Apriori algorithm under the same data set, and there is no obvious difference in the generated frequent itemset and association rules. This shows that the decision tree strategy and parallelization processing method can effectively improve the efficiency of the algorithm, which is suitable for the association rule mining task of largescale datasets.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Support Vector Machine with Random Forest and Multilayer Perceptron for the Quality Assessment of Rice
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Rice is one of the most important item included in our daily diet. In market rice is being traded as cheaper quality one irrespective of various regions which might affect the customer's health and may lead to new diseases. In order to overcome this issue, there are various techniques that helps to check the rice quality using different ML techniques. Hence there is high time necessary to calculate the performance and to check quality of rice using SVM-support vector machine, random forest and MLP-multilayer perceptron. The accuracy achieved for SVM ranges about 59.00 to 67.00, random forest achieved is 70.00 to 74.00. Thus, we conclude that neural networks found with highest accuracy compared to other techniques such as SVM and random forest and multi- layer perceptron are better. The work states that the findings such as compared to CNN, SVM, KNN HOG and random forest trees and MLP holds better accuracies than SVM.

articleTitle: Solution of Optimal Power Flow Problems Using Modified Hunter Pray Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This work presents a new hybrid metaheuristic algorithm specifically developed to solve the Optimal Power Flow (OPF) problems. The OPF problem aims to minimize real power loss, quadratic fuel cost, and complex nonlinear fuel cost, while considering the impact of valve point loading (VPL) effects. This is done to maintain an economically efficient operational condition in a power system. The proposed hybrid algorithm combines the mutualism phase of the Symbiotic Organism Search Algorithm (SOSA) with the Hunter-Prey Optimization Algorithm (HPOA) in order to improve the local search capabilities of HPOA. HPOA manages the global search process, whereas SOSA and HPOA operate together during the mutualism phase and local search process, respectively. This combined technique effectively addresses complex nonlinear optimization problems. The proposed method is applied to determine the optimal settings to minimize real power loss, simple quadratic fuel cost and the fuel cost with VPL. The IEEE 30 bus system is used to evaluate the algorithm that is being considered. After that, its results are compared to those of other published algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-modal Bird Species Identification: Integrating Deep Neural Networks, Transfer Learning, and Spectrogram Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The proposed research presents a comprehensive study on the identification of bird species using a multimodal approach. We explore three distinct methodologies: 1. Deep neural network based identification, 2. Spectrogram based bird audio analysis and 3. Transfer learning based feature extraction. We observed that the ResNet50 model achieved the highest accuracy of 99.40% on the test dataset, outperforming other models. This research not only provides insights into the effectiveness of deep neural networks but also explores the potential of transfer learning and spectrogram analysis for robust bird species identification across multiple modalities. This multimodal approach contributes valuable insights to the fields of ornithology, biodiversity monitoring, and wildlife conservation.

articleTitle: Stress Monitoring and Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Stress is a pervasive and debilitating condition that affects individuals across various aspects of work in day-to-day life. The first aspect involves vigilant observation of physical, emotional, and behavioral symptoms to identify stressors. Physical signs, such as headaches and changes in appetite, emotional indicators like anxiety and irritability, and behavioral changes, such as social withdrawal, serve as key markers for stress assessment. Stress management is a proactive approach to mitigate the impact of stress on overall well-being. However, with the advent of technology, various tools and applications have emerged to assist in stress monitoring and management. Our approach involves the use of a machine learning (ML) algorithm to analyze the data that is collected by the sensors and communicated with the help of Raspberry Pi. The results indicate that the Decision Tree algorithm provides significant accuracy of 98.4 % with an F1 score of 0.98. This data is then used to analyze the current state of the user and provide haptic feedback if necessary.

articleTitle: Real-Time Dehazing and Defogging: A Comprehensive Analysis for Single Image Haze and Fog Removal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Implementing image dehazing and defogging on a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) offers efficiency. Dehazing an image becomes particularly challenging in the presence of fog or haze. However, employing a dark channel prior to dehazing allows the removal of haze particles from the image. Different modules are used in this process, such as Dynamic Atmospheric Light Estimation (DALE), Scene Recovery (SR), and Transmission Map Estimation (TME). The FPGA runs these modules in hardware and produces effective outcomes by employing image processing algorithms. In this case, using FPGA technology offers a number of benefits. The dehazing process can be accelerated by using FPGA's built-in parallel processing capabilities to execute numerous operations at once. Furthermore, FPGA implementations provide better throughput and reduced latency in comparison to conventional approaches, making them well-suited for real-time applications such as image dehazing and D

articleTitle: Integrating CNN and KNN for Enhanced Celery Variety Classification in India: A Detailed Three-Class Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Crop variety classification has a very important part in agricultural productivity, breeding programs, and research. In this work, we suggest an approach combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and the classical K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm to enhance celery variety classification in India. Specifically, we focus on the classification of three prominent celery varieties: Pusa Jyoti, Utah, and Pusa Lehar. The proposed approach emphasizes thorough data gathering, preparation, model creation, and testing. The application of deep learning techniques using CNNs for the feature extraction from a celery image and KNN classifier is used. The performance of the CNN-KNN integrated method is evaluated using standard classification metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure. The experimental results confirm the proposed method's potency with an overall accuracy of 92.5% on the test set. Compared to the latest methods, comparison analysis with our approach successively proves us to give better accuracy and reliability from celery variety classification. The results of this research are fundamental to the management of agriculture, breeding programs, and marketing analysis, providing easy-to-adopt and affordable solutions for crop varieties categorization in the whole range of agricultural contexts.

articleTitle: Analysis of High-Performance Design Metrics for Multipliers using Novel System Design Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The QCA is a new paradigm in the field of VLSI nanotechnology. The quantum dot, which uses the polarization of electrons to express binary information, is the basic building component of QCA. In contrast to technologies like CMOS, GDI, and MGDI, this innovative technique enables us to create any kind of logical circuit with less space, less power, and less delay. Since QCA operates on principle of quantum mechanics it consumes less power, speed of the circuit can be limited by the electron tunnelling between the quantum dots, and it occupies minimal area as it uses quantum dots to represent the circuit. It takes a high level of proficiency in digital logic design, fabrication techniques, and quantum physics to develop high performance multipliers like Baugh Wooley, Wallace-Tree, Array multipliers. The key objective of this research is to develop a QCA-based multiplier architecture that is dependable and efficient, capable of outperforming electronic multipliers in terms of speed and low power consumption. A comparative analysis between QCA based multipliers and conventional electronic multipliers will be conducted, showcasing the applications of Quantum-Dot Cellular Automata.

articleTitle: Multi-Resolution Transform Based Image Fusion for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Underwater images captured by imaging equipment are affected by factors such as absorption, scattering, and illumination, resulting in very poor image quality. In this paper, a method for enhancing underwater images based on dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DT-CWT) is proposed for improving the visual features of underwater images. Adaptive histogram equalization like CLAHE and multi-scale retinex are employed on the frequency components to assist in enhancing the brightness and contrast of the underwater image. The haze in the image is reduced by color correction provided by multiscale retinex algorithm. The enhanced image is reconstructed by combining the processed low-frequency and high-frequency components using the inverse transform. The proposed method is evaluated on two underwater image datasets UIEB and EUVP and the results are compared with existing methods. The experimental results demonstrate that the suggested method significantly enhances the quality and visibility of underwater images. The proposed approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in subjective and objective aspects.

articleTitle: Optimization of Rainfall Prediction Using Satellite Data Through Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In recent years, non-periodic rainfall has increased globally. The importance of accurate rainfall prediction model is increased in order to reduce the losses due to floods and drought. Rainfall prediction plays a crucial role in decision-making, flood and drought risk assessment and management. In agriculture, it guides many farmers in optimizing crop planting schedules and irrigation. It ensures better yields and reduces losses from droughts and floods. Accurate rainfall prediction benefits us in effective water resource management and energy sector planning. In India, the rainfall varies rapidly due to the vast geography. There are many factors which effects rainfall like distance from the sea, seasons, the presence of mountains, prevailing winds and precipitation. This research work mainly focuses on developing an efficient ensemble-based Machine Learning Techniques such as Extreme Gradient boosting algorithm (XG Boost) and Logistic Regression (LR) for predicting rainfall in different regions of India using satellite data and comparing results with the deep learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Multiple Layer Perceptron (MLP), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Radial Basis Function Network (RBF). The aim of this paper is to overcome the drawbacks of existing systems and build improved prediction model with accuracy more than 90% in order to enhance water resource management, early warning systems, improved urban planning, agriculture, and climate change studies.

articleTitle: Application of PLC Dcs Control System in Electronic Control System of Automatic Production Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The application of electronic control system is critical in the automatic production line, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Embedded control is unable to address the production line control in automated production lines issue in the automatic production line, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a PLC type DCS control system-based application of PLC DCS control system in electronic control system of automatic production line is provided, and in electronic control system of automatic production line is assessed. To begin, the modern control theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the application of electronic control system's needs to decrease interference factors in the application of electronic control system. The modern control theory is then used to create a PLC type DCS control system application of electronic control system scheme, and the outcomes of the application of electronic control system are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the PLC type DCS control system outperforms the standard Embedded control in terms of application of electronic control system accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation Practice of Financial Sharing in the Power Industry Driven by Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The role of transformation mechanism evaluation in the financial management of the power industry is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate evaluation of results. The traditional financial management model cannot solve the problem of evaluation of transformation mechanism in the financial management of the power industry, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a data mining algorithm to evaluate and analyze the innovative transformation mechanism. Firstly, the financial management theory is used to evaluate accounting, and the indicators are divided according to the evaluation requirements of the transformation mechanism to reduce the interference factors in the evaluation of the transformation mechanism. Then, the financial management theory evaluates the transformation mechanism of financial management of electric power enterprises, forms a transformation mechanism evaluation plan, and comprehensively analyzes the evaluation results of the transformation mechanism. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the evaluation accuracy and evaluation time of the transformation mechanism of the financial management of power enterprises by data mining algorithms are better than those of traditional financial management models.

Author Keywords: innovation and entrepreneurship of college students

articleTitle: Wick-Based Hydroponics System with Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The proposed system is designed to address resource efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and user convenience, thereby promoting accessible and eco-friendly agricultural practices. Employs readily available and reusable materials, emphasizing sustain ability and afford ability. Utilizing wick-based technology relying on capillary action to deliver nutrient-rich water directly to plant roots. The thyme seedlings are placed inside pots that are filled with an inert growing medium to support the plant, and a wick material is used for optimal nutrient absorption. The wick facilitates capillary action, delivering nutrient solution directly to the plant roots, thereby minimizing water wastage. The system utilizes sensors to measure key parameters such as pH, EC, and humidity to measure the nutrient concentration in the hydroponics solution. A mobile application serves as the central control interface, authorizing users to monitor nutrient levels, and water levels remotely. Through real-time data analysis by utilizing the sensor measurements, the application displays the nutrient delivery graph, humidity level, and water level parameters automatically for the user to monitor the plant growth.

articleTitle: Design of FIR Filter Using a Novel Approach with High-Speed Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Systems for digital signal processing and communication require finite impulse response filters that offers linear phase response and stability. The proposed multiplier, implemented using Xilinx Vivado, targets the reduction of high delay and power consumption associated with existing designs. The development of the bit pair recoding algorithm is a key contribution, enhancing the efficiency of filter design for VLSI applications. The project aims to improve the speed and effectiveness of VLSI systems by employing efficient multipliers and FIR filters. Filter architectures can vary based on area, power consumption, and time delay, making optimization crucial. The outcome of the paper includes a detailed analysis comparing the new multiplier with existing designs to demonstrate its superior performance in terms of speed, power efficiency, and overall effectiveness in FIR filter applications.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Using Transfer Learning for Brain Tumor Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Analyzing brain tumors without using human intervention is seen as a crucial field of study. Nevertheless, convolutional neural networks (CNN) can be used to do this. They have achieved remarkable success in resolving issues related to computer vision as well as numerous other issues like visual object detection, recognition, and segmentation. By using segmentation techniques that are extremely resilient to noise and cluster size sensitivity issues for automatic Region Of Interest (ROI) recognition, brain pictures are optimized for the purpose of detecting brain tumors. The great accuracy of CNNs and the lack of need for human feature extraction make them a popular choice. It is difficult to identify a brain tumor and to precisely determine its type. The performance of CNN is better than others because it is widely used in image recognition. One of the most significant and difficult problems in medical imaging is brain tumor segmentation since manual classification with human assistance might result in incorrect diagnosis and prognoses. Furthermore, handling a big volume of data makes it a challenging process. Brain tumors are very different in appearance, and the tumor and normal tissues are similar, making it difficult to distinguish tumor areas from images.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Switching Controller for a Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs) have significant attention due to their potential to address the pressing need for transportation systems that are both efficient and environmentally friendly. By reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving the total effectiveness of energy. This paper presents a simulation study focusing on various scenarios of switching modes between EV and ICE. Using a MATLAB/Simulink® environment, the findings are validated through comprehensive simulations. A comparative analysis is conducted, specifically evaluating variables such as vehicle speed, battery SOC, and fuel. The following analysis presents the performance characteristics of different types of hybrid vehicle topologies. Based on these findings, the paper proposes the development of a Fuzzy PID controller for an adaptive switching controller in HEV. The simulation results are analyzed, and results are presented.

Author Keywords: Mode switching Between EV and ICE

articleTitle: Electrocardiogram Pulse Wave Analysis for Holistic Cardiovascular Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to non-invasive heart health assessment by integrating pulse data obtained from the human wrist with machine learning techniques. Drawing inspiration from ancient Ayurvedic techniques like Nadi Pariksha, we analyze pulse characteristics such as shape, intensity, and frequency to deduce potential health conditions, offering tailored treatment approaches. Employing portable pulse data capturing instruments in non-hospital settings, we relay the collected data to a model of machine learning that applies pattern analysis for classifying health conditions. By extrapolating insights from diverse datasets, we enhance the accuracy and applicability of our model's classifications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Field-Oriented Control for BLDC Motors in Electric Vehicles Using Bio-Inspired Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Bio-Inspired Algorithm for Field-Oriented BLDC Motor Control in Electric Vehicles,” indicates a research focused on the application of algorithms inspired by biological processes to control brush-less DC (BLDC) motors in electric vehicles (EVs) using a field-oriented control (FOC) strategy. This is a sophisticated and contemporary area of study that merges insights from nature (bio-inspiration) with advanced electrical engineering and control systems to enhance the efficiency, performance, and reliability of EV propulsion systems. Electric vehicles (EVs) represent a cornerstone of the transition towards more sustainable transportation systems. Among various technologies, brush-less DC (BLDC) motors are widely recognized for their high efficiency, reliability, and power-to- weight ratio, making them ideal for EV applications. However, optimizing their performance in dynamic driving conditions remains a challenge, necessitating advanced control strategies. A novel bio-inspired algorithm for the field-oriented control (FOC) of BLDC motors in EVs. Inspired by the adaptive and efficient strategies observed in biological systems, our algorithm aims to enhance the motor's performance across a wide range of operating conditions, focusing on energy efficiency, torque ripple reduction, and robustness against parameter variations and external disturbances. To develop the bio-inspired algorithm by drawing parallels between biological adaptability mechanisms and the dynamic requirements of BLDC motor control. The proposed algorithm was integrated into the FOC framework, a vector control strategy that decouples the motor's magnetic flux and torque components for precise control. The effectiveness of the algorithm was evaluated through a series of simulations and real-world tests, comparing its performance with traditional FOC methods and other bio-inspired control strategies. The bio- inspired algorithm demonstrated significant improvements in several key performance metrics. Specifically, it achieved a 15% increase in energy efficiency and a 25% reduction in torque ripple compared to conventional FOC methods. Moreover, the algorithm exhibited superior adaptability to parameter variations and external disturbances, ensuring stable and optimized motor performance under diverse operating conditions. The integration of bio-inspired algorithms into the field-oriented control of BLDC motors presents a promising avenue for enhancing the performance and efficiency of electric vehicle propulsion systems. By leveraging the principles of biological adaptability, this approach offers a novel solution to the complex challenges of EV motor control, paving the way for more sustainable and efficient transportation options.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Power 3-Bit Encoder Using Memristor on LT Spice
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The utilization of memristors in the design of digital logic gates presents a promising alternative to current IC architectures. By leveraging memristors, there is potential for increased transistor density on chips, as they can be integrated atop the polysilicon gate of NMOS transistors, simplifying manufacturing processes. Furthermore, the implementation of MRL gates, such as in the proposed 3-bit encoder, demonstrates advantages in power dissipation when compared to traditional CMOS designs. This encoder serves as a versatile tool for modeling various combinational logic circuits, with this paper focusing on the detailed design and analysis of a 3-bit encoder using different logic configurations through LT Spice simulations. The purpose of the low power 3-bit encoder is to convert a 3-bit binary input into a one-hot encoded output. It is designed for low-power applications, aiming to minimize energy consumption while maintaining accurate and efficient encoding. This project aims to design a low-power 3-bit encoder using memristor technology, exploring its potential for energy-efficient digital circuitry. Memristors, emerging electronic components with unique characteristics, offer opportunities for novel circuit designs. The objective is to create an encoder that converts 3-bit binary inputs into a specified output format while minimizing power consumption. The project involves circuit design, memristor characterization, simulation, power analysis, and comparative evaluation against conventional designs. By showcasing the advantages of memristors in energy-efficient encoding, this work contributes to the advancement of modern electronics and provides insights into the practical applications of memristor technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact and Mechanism of Artificial Intelligence on Consumption Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: As the only way to comprehensively expand domestic demand, consumption upgrading gradually reflects the impact and mechanism of consumption upgrading with the development of artificial intelligence technology. The role of mechanism evaluation in consumption structure under artificial intelligence is very important, but there is a problem of inaccurate outcome evaluation. The traditional consumption model cannot solve the problem of evaluation of the mechanism of consumption structure under artificial intelligence, and the evaluation is unreasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a data mining algorithm to evaluate and analyze the mechanism of optimization and innovation. Firstly, the relative income consumption theory is used to evaluate the consumer market, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the mechanism evaluation to reduce the interference factors in the evaluation of the mechanism. Then, the relative income consumption theory evaluates the mechanism of consumption upgrading level, forms a mechanism evaluation scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the evaluation results of the mechanism. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the evaluation accuracy of the mechanism of data mining algorithms on the level of consumption upgrading and the quality of consumption structure transformation and upgrading are better than those of traditional consumption patterns.

articleTitle: Hyperparameter Tuning and Validation of Neural Network Model for Software Effort Estimation with NCA Based Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Effort estimators and Project managers still struggle with estimating the project effort. Early in a project, a high degree of ambiguity and inexperience lead to inaccurate estimates of the amount of work needed. Soft computing techniques such as artificial neural networks (ANNs), fuzzy logic and genetic algorithms are the most preferred software effort estimation approaches. This study compares two different types of ANNs, feed-forward neural networks (FFNN) and cascade-forward neural networks (CFNN) for software effort estimation. The number of neurons in the hidden layer, and activation functions of layers are hyperparameters to be tuned prior to training. This paper performed trial-and-error approach for tuning the hyperparameters of ANN to reach the optimum architecture of ANN. Nonparametric feature selection technique, neighborhood component analysis (NCA) was utilized to improve the prediction accuracy. The use of NCA improves the prediction accuracy of ANN. This study also demonstrates the need for normalization of the data for accurate estimation of response variables. The work is validated with two datasets i.e. coc81 and china datasets using a 2-fold cross-validation approach using 12 performance metrics. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed technique in contrast to the use of ANN without normalization and feature selection.

articleTitle: An Early Identification of Rice Leaf Diseases Through Efficient DenseNet20 1 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Rice is the primary food source in India and many other countries worldwide. The need for rice has grown significantly along with the world's population. The populace is currently facing enormous challenges in ensuring enough food accessibility due to rising rice plant disease rates and increased demand. Many rice leaf diseases can result in significant financial losses for both nations and farmers. Reducing the incidence of rice leaf disease in rice-producing areas is the ultimate goal in order to save livelihoods and promote sustainable economic development. This work uses the DenseNet201 model to classify rice leaf diseases. The model is implemented on Epoch30, Epoch40, and Epoch50, where, at epoch30, the training phase yielded an accuracy of 96.09% and a loss of 0.1040. Next, after applying epoch 40 there is an increase of 97.71 % and a decrease in loss as 0.0514. Observations show that the model shows the maximum accuracy and least amount of loss when epoch50 is finally employed. With epoch50, the accuracy and loss are 1.0000 and 0.0352, respectively.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Text based Sentiment Analysis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Vast growth in the customers of the social media platform leads to automatic sentiment analysis based on the review, post, profile, and comment text to characterize the emotional status of customers. Text-based sentiment analysis is challenging due to variants in the context, content, semantics, grammar, and understanding of the particular language. This paper provides a comparative analysis of Deep Convolution Neural Network (DCNN), Deep Belief Network (DBN), and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) for text-based sentiment recognition. The results of these techniques are evaluated on the public GoEmotion dataset based on recall, accuracy, precision, selectivity, negative predictive rate, and F1-score. It provides the analytical findings of the different deep learning (DL) frameworks and their advantages and disadvantages. Further, it delivers the potential areas of improvement in deep learning-based sentiment analysis in the future.

articleTitle: Estimation of Portable Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Energy plays the central part and key role of each and every system. Among all energy sources stability and portability are desired features. Battery is fulfilling the required features as power and energy source. Battery management system is a circuit that monitors battery modules and balances inter modules. It checks and processes parameters. Decentralised BMS needs more control and monitoring than centralised BMS. BMS measures various parameters such as voltages, current and temperatures in the battery module for determining the state of charge (SOC) and also the effect of discharging rate on the capacity of a cell is analyzed.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The various uses of hand gesture detection systems and their capacity to facilitate effective machine-human interaction have garnered significant interest in recent years. An overview of current hand gesture recognition systems is provided in this study. The challenges of the gesture system are highlighted with key issues of the hand gesture recognition system. Additionally, a review of the recent motions and gesture detection technology is provided. A synopsis of the research findings for databases, hand gesture techniques, and a comparison of the key stages of gesture recognition are also provided. Finally, the benefits and cons of the systems under discussion are clarified. Though there is a large social group that could benefit from it, the concept of using technology to recognize sign language is not widely used. There are numerous technologies at this disposal that could be useful in creating a connection between this social group and the outside world. Knowing sign language is one of the keystones to empowering users to interact with the general public. Computers are able to comprehend sign language through the application of machine learning and picture classification, which people can then interpret. This study uses convolutional neural networks to identify sign language motions. The RGB camera was used to capture static sign language gestures for the image collection.

articleTitle: Implement a PnR Flow to Boost the Pin Density in Block Level Chip Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: During the physical design process., it is usual to come across pin density in the placement stage. As cell geometry becomes smaller and smaller pin density plays an important role in timing management and congestion in a physical design process., a higher pin density results in congestion issues., while a lower pin density affects the timing of the integrated circuit. In this research, we present an analysis of the physical design process for a 40nm technology to enhance pin density in less congested regions and improve high-density regions using cell padding and uniform density techniques with the help of the ICC2 tool.

articleTitle: Routing with Interference Reduction and Opportunistic Estimation Against Multiple Jammers in MANETs with Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The routing for a wireless network in multi-hop scenario can be actively attacked by jammers which severely deteriorate the performance of the network. One of the important examples is a mobile ad hoc network in which the legitimate nodes move and harvest energy from the radio environment. The challenges are that the jammers continuously vary their jamming signals, transmit with a power which is much larger than that of the legitimate nodes, and all their instantaneous channel gains are unknown. We propose two novel schemes of opportunistic combination and removal of the jamming signals from the dominant jammer by using the estimates of the channel ratios. Simulation results show that the proposed schemes are better than a conventional scheme in terms of the total delivery time, number of hops, and successful delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Underwater Image Enhancement Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Absorption, scattering, and colour distortion make underwater photography difficult. Marine biology, underwater archaeology, and surveillance need better underwater photos. This research compares cutting-edge underwater image-enhancing methods to assess their efficacy and usefulness. This paper provides a comparative analysis of the various filtering approaches for underwater image enhancement, such as median filtering, average filtering, Gaussian filtering, Wiener filtering, and wavelet-based soft thresholding. The performance of these techniques is evaluated based on the mean square error, peak signal-to-noise ratio, average gradient, PCQI, and UICQI. The effectiveness of the suggested filtering scheme is validated on some sample images of the public UIEB dataset. It provides the analytical finding, advantages, disadvantages and performance of the different techniques for wide variety of underwater images enhancement. The paper also explores underwater image enhancement issues and future approaches. The promising research directions are integrating domain-specific information, real-time processing, and adaptive algorithms for dynamic underwater scenes. The discoveries help increase underwater photography visibility and interpretability, increasing underwater exploration and monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Analysing Digits with Sequential Convolutional Neural Networks and Adam Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Numerical analysis is the focus of this study, which employs the Adam optimizer in conjunction with CNNs. Computer vision and deep learning have enabled exact number recognition, which is crucial for many current applications such as optical character recognition and automated document processing. The chosen Sequential CNN design is perfect for efficient feature representation and extraction of basic services because of its pooling and convolutional layers. The Adam optimizer's ability to adjust the learning rate makes model training more efficient and speeds up convergence. Improving the model's accuracy is the main focus of the study. This may be achieved by methods such as regularisation, data augmentation, and hyperparameter tuning. Using assessment tools such as confusion matrices and classification reports, you may find out everything about the model's strengths and weaknesses. The model's capacity to produce and adapt to new numerical data sets is proven as it undergoes training, evaluation, and optimisation. The positive outcomes achieved by integrating a well-designed Sequential CNN with the Adam optimizer demonstrate the method's applicability to digit identification issues. This paper contributes to the ongoing discussion in computer vision and machine learning by exploring the complexities of digit analysis utilising Sequential CNNs and the Adam optimizer. The study does more than just establish a social solid foundation for accurate number identification; it also paves the way for future advancements in the broader area of AI applications as it shows a perfect precision.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sustainability in Photovoltaic Technology: Optimization of NH2(CH2)2NH3MnCl4 Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The study explores the optimization of PSC based on (NH(CH2)2NH3MnCI4) with the goal of improving their environmental sustainability, stability, and efficiency. It investigates the complex impacts of BDD, ND, and NA on device performance by methodical variations. Donors affect charge carrier concentrations and production, whereas acceptors are essential to charge transit and extraction in PSCs. On the other side, defects might hinder a device's functionality by serving as recombination hubs. Utilizing cutting-edge material engineering methods like surface passivation and doping, it seeks to increase device stability and efficiency by optimizing these factors. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{OC}}=1.47 \%, \mathrm{J}_{\text{SC}}=17.45 \text{mA} / \text{cm}^2, \text{FF}=86.38 \%,$</tex>. and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{PCE}=22.16\%$</tex> are the study's maximum results. The development of reliable and efficient PV technology is advanced by this work. It supports international efforts to slow down climate change, provide access to sustainable energy sources, and encourage the development of innovative clean energy technologies. The foundation for PSCs' broad acceptance and integration into a variety of applications is laid by this study, which will speed up the shift to a more sustainable energy future. It seeks to solve the issues of scalability, dependability, and environmental effect through multidisciplinary collaboration and ongoing research efforts, opening the door for a more environmentally friendly and sustainable energy landscape.

articleTitle: To Enhance VANET Communication Services using a Metaheuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: As a subtype of mobile ad hoc networks, vehicle ad hoc networks (VANETs) are regarded as the essential elements of intelligent transportation systems (ITS). It permits vehicle-to-vehicle communication when some roadside base stations function as fixed infrastructures and movement is constrained by a VANET mobility model. For applications in this delicate field, accurate data transmission is always necessary and from any location. Thus, to achieve optimal multicast routing, the VANET routing protocols must be suitably modified to satisfy the quality of service (QoS) criteria. Since clustering improves VANET communication services, it is essential to VANET routing communication. In this paper, clustering is being used to provide efficient VANET services. Performance analysis is done with the Metaheuristic algorithm such as the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA). Analysis shows the NSGA provides efficient VANET communication services as compared to the Genetic Algorithm (GA), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).

articleTitle: Simulation of Enterprise Financial Management Early Warning Model Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Model simulation evaluation plays a crucial role in forecasting enterprise financial management risks, yet it often suffers from imprecise outcome assessments. Traditional statistical models fall short in addressing these evaluation challenges within corporate finance settings, leading to suboptimal evaluations. To address this, the study introduces an innovative neural network algorithm tailored for model simulation assessment and analysis. Initially, financial management's predictive theory guides the parameter assessment for our model, with indicators categorized based on specific simulation evaluation needs to diminish interfering variables. Subsequently, this theory is employed to simulate and scrutinize the corporate financial risk prediction model, resulting in a detailed model simulation evaluation strategy and a thorough analysis of its outcomes. MATLAB simulations confirm that, against set criteria, the neural network algorithm's simulation for corporate financial risk prediction surpasses traditional statistical models in evaluation precision and enhancing business decision-making efficacy.

articleTitle: Design of Accurate, Power and Area Efficient 16X16 Multiplier using Approximation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Effective multiplication is necessary in high-power computer applications like signal and image processing. Even though approximate arithmetic compromises output precision, it presents an achievable path towards designing energy-efficient digital systems with minimal environmental impact. The paper outlines the design of approximate multipliers, utilizing both conventional and approximate Half Adders & Full Adders by strategically placing for adding partial products at the Most Significant Bit (MSB) positions and OR gates are utilized to add the partial products at the Lower Significant Bit (LSB) positions. In addition, this research paper shows the 16x16 multipliers of unsigned and signed by incorporating clock gating for enhanced power reduction. The Verilog HDL implementation the proposed multiplier includes simulations using Artix-7 AC701 FPGA on Xilinx VIVADO design tool. The results found that an enhance accuracy while potentially reducing power usage by 11.8% and 15.8%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection with Grey Wolf Optimization-Tuned Neural Networks in a Big Data Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Nowadays, the effective intrusion detection and study of secure landscapes in big data environment faces many challenges. This work intends to employ an intrusion detection scheme, which encompasses three phases “(i) Preprocessing, (ii) Feature Extraction, and (iii) Intrusion Detection”. Initially, the input data is pre-processed with hadoop and map reduced frameworks that aids in the process of data normalization. Then, from the normalized data, flow based features are extracted that are then given to the intrusion detection phase. Optimized Neural Network (NN) is used for this purpose. For more precise prediction, the training (weight) of NN is done by”Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) Algorithm” via tuning the optimal weight. Finally, the superiority of the developed model is assessed by comparison with existing methods.

articleTitle: Efficient Clocking Strategies for Adiabatic Quantum-Flux-Parametron 8-bit Ripple Carry Adder Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The implementation of an Adiabatic Quantum-Flux-Parametron (AQFP) 8-bit Ripple Carry Adder with the capability to operate indifferent clock cycles is explored in this study. Leveraging Superconducting digital circuits employing Josephson junctions, this approach garners significant attention due to its ultra-fast operation and minimal energy consumption. In this study, we investigate the implementation of an Adiabatic Quantum-Flux-Parametron (AQFP) 8-bit Ripple Carry Adder with the flexibility to operate across different clock cycles. Leveraging the capabilities of Superconducting digital circuits and Josephson junctions, this approach is notable for its rapid operation and minimal energy consumption. Our focus lies on examining the effects of varying clock cycles on key performance parameters. A comprehensive analysis of memory usage, CPU utilization, and execution time is presented for different phase delays corresponding to 1 clock cycle, 2 clock cycles, both 1 and 2 clock cycles, and no clock cycle. The results indicate subtle fluctuations in memory usage, CPU utilization, and execution time across these configurations, providing insights into the system's adaptability to different clocking schemes. Furthermore, we propose a novel clocking strategy tailored specifically for AQFP circuits, termed as “indifferent clock cycles,” which allows for seamless operation irrespective of the clock cycle duration. Through this approach, we aim to optimize system performance while accommodating diverse operational requirements. By exploring the implications of indifferent clock cycles on AQFP-based systems, we aim to pave the way for more versatile and efficient superconducting digital circuits. This research contributes to the ongoing efforts in advancing the field of quantum-flux-parametron logic and its applications in high-performance computing systems.

articleTitle: Pipeline Leak Detection System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Leak detection is a critical concern across various sectors due to its potential environmental, economic, and safety implications. This paper presents a machine learning-based approach aimed at enhancing leak detection strategies, focusing on predicting the distance and diameter of leaks in pipelines. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset sourced from experimental setups featuring deliberate leaks, our model utilizes pressure and flow measurements to accurately identify and localize leaks. Through rigorous evaluation of multiple machine learning algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbors, XGBoost, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine, we identify XGBoost for predicting leak distances and Random Forest for estimating leak diameters as optimal choices. The proposed approach demonstrates promising results in accurately detecting and quantifying pipeline leaks, offering valuable insights for ensuring pipeline integrity and safety.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Web-Based Relationship Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the customer relationship of foreign trade companies, the design and implementation of management and operating system play a key role, but there is the problem of inaccurate management. The traditional ant colony algorithm can't effectively solve the system design problem in the customer relationship of foreign trade companies, and the effect is not satisfactory. Therefore, this paper puts forward the design and implementation of the customer relationship management system of foreign trade companies based on network, and analyzes the design and implementation of the customer relationship management system of foreign trade companies. Firstly, the network convergence theory is used to locate the influencing factors, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of management system design and implementation, so as to reduce the interference factors in management system design and implementation. Then, the design scheme of network management system is formed by using the theory of network convergence, and the MATLAB simulation results of management system design and implementation are comprehensively analyzed. The MAT LAB simulation results show that under some evaluation criteria, the network is superior to the traditional ant colony algorithm in the design and implementation accuracy of the management system, the design and implementation of the management system, and the time of the management system influencing factors.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Diabetes Detection Using User Interface Designing Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This study delves into the application of predictive modelling in healthcare, specifically focusing on diabetes. Utilizing logistic regression, a well-established statistical algorithm, the research aims to predict the likelihood of diabetes by analysing a diverse dataset encompassing demographic details, medical history, lifestyle factors, and biochemical indicators. The model's performance is evaluated through metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Key predictors associated with diabetes risk are identified, enhancing our understanding of the disease, and facilitating targeted interventions. Feature selection techniques are applied for model interpretability, and comparative assessments with alternative algorithms validate the efficacy of logistic regression. The findings contribute valuable insights to personalized healthcare strategies and public health initiatives, emphasizing the significance of early identification and intervention for improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Landscape Design Strategy in Residential Park Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The landscape design strategy optimization is critical in the healthy landscape of residential parks, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Bee colony algorithm is unable to address the strategy optimization design issue in the healthy landscape of residential parks, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Intelligent algorithms-based research on optimization of healthy landscape design strategy of residential park is provided, and the research on optimization of healthy landscape design strategy of residential park is assessed.
