Paul Milgrom in his auction procedure proposes an efficient method-ology for allocating resources, encouraging competition and clarity. Especially, the SMRA (Simultaneously multiple-round auction) facilitates efficient resource allotment by permitting clients to perform combination-based bidding over numerous iterations. Via iterative alterations steered by price updations, clients can revise their proposed bids to correctly coincide with their exact requirements. This research article proposes a novel CloudAuc procedure, founded upon Paul Milgrom's bidding methodology, as a creative strategy for enhancing resource allotment in cloud architectures. By promoting truthful bidding and responsively enhancing resource allotment, CloudAuc strives to enhance precision, clarity, and resilience in cloud architectures, thereby promoting resource allotment procedures in centralized frameworks.

articleTitle: An Advanced YOLOv7 Model for Vehicle Detection to Enhance the Security of Public Places
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Vehicle detection is discussed in detail using the YOLOv7 model based on an advanced deep learning approach, which demonstrates excellent performance as a vehicle detector under different conditions. A crucial feature of this study is the implementation of YOLOv7 - a model known for its speed and precision in object detection tasks. We painstakingly trained and tested the model on a very broad dataset which resulted in an excellent performance. The model highly performed in the detection with an accuracy of 98.35%, a testimony on its utility to detect various items under complex circumstances. Parallel to this, the model exhibite a low loss percentage of 0.3321 which translates into effectiveness in minimizing losses during detection time. To clarify the performance of this model, we included a comprehensive quantitative analysis by including precision-recall curves and also a confusion matrix. These analysis not only support the high-precision but also provide information on the strengths and weaknesses of model in multiple vehicular situations. Notably, a comparative analysis with the older Yolo versions and also other popular deep learning models in vehicle detection was also carried out. This comparison, which is illustrated through a set of graphs and tables, clearly highlight the evolution progress and precedence in terms of accuracy as well as speed over The YOLOv7 model. Practical implications of these findings are large for a number of different applications that include autonomous driving, traffic management and also planning cities. The high precision and low loss rate of the YOLOv7 model highlight its applicability in safety improvement on the transportation systems. Thus, this research presents a very valuable insight into the field of vehicle detection by providing empirical evidence in combination with sophisticated analytical techniques to showcase YOLOv7 model's practical application performance.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Detection and Classification Using SVM and GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurological condition that gradually affects memory, thinking, and cognitive function, particularly in the elderly, especially those over 65. Although the exact cause of the disorder is still unknown, it is thought to be influenced by environmental triggers, genetic factors, or other unknown variables. Clinical evaluations and imaging techniques such as CT scans, X-ray scans, and positron emission tomography are utilized for illness analysis, with X-ray exams being the most frequently used. The research also uses MRI scans to classify the condition into four stages: healthy, slightly demented, moderately demented, and very mildly demented. For sickness ID, our proposed model utilizes the viability, constancy, and exactness of SVM and GAN profound learning procedures. The dataset was downloaded from Kaggle and improved with GAN to expand its lavishness. The dataset was isolated into preparing and testing sets in a 80:20 ratio after pre-handling techniques were utilized to guarantee information homogeneity. The model was able to classify all of the data with an astonishing 98% accuracy using feature extraction and SVM-based classification. This innovative model enables medical professionals to create individualized, effective treatment plans based on each patient's specific needs by assisting them with accurate illness diagnosis and progression assessment.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality in Electronics and Communication Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper explores the integration of virtual reality (VR) technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) education. A virtual lab is developed, allowing users to interact with electronic components and access detailed descriptions with related data. The lab offers a dynamic and immersive learning environment, enhancing student engagement and understanding of complex concepts. Through VR, students can manipulate components, observe their behavior, and gain practical insights. Additionally, users can perform circuit connections within the virtual environment, providing a hands-on experience in building and testing circuits. This capability allows students to experiment with various circuit configurations and understand the principles of circuit design and analysis. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of VR in ECE education, providing a cost-effective and scalable solution for hands-on learning.

articleTitle: Secure Transmission of Ballots Using Blind Signature for Electronic Voting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In a blind signature system, the signer signs a digital document without being aware of the content of the message being signed. This technique is meant to ensure signature legitimacy while keeping the signer in the dark about the message's contents. Blind signatures can be used for secure ballot transmission in electronic voting (e-voting) to enhance privacy and ensure the confidentiality of voters' choices. The concept of blind signatures is particularly valuable in the context of electronic voting systems, where preserving voter anonymity is a crucial consideration. This work proposes an e-voting scheme and implements blind signatures using the Rivest-Shamir-Adleman algorithm for secure transmission of ballots. In this proposed e-voting scheme, the signer signs ballots only for the eligible voters using the blind signature technology. Without knowing the voters' identities, other parties can confirm the legitimacy of the ballots. Thus, this scheme preserves the ballot's authenticity while protecting voters' privacy. Voters can login and register using a token-based authentication method.

articleTitle: A Quadruped Robot with Limbs Integrating Linear Actuator and Revolute Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper aims to develop a cost-effective quadruped robot capable of navigating diverse terrains and environments addressing the limitations of wheeled vehicles. Quadruped robots hold great potential in various industries, including agriculture, security and unmanned ground vehicles(UGV). Normally, a quadruped robot's leg is designed to replicate an animal's leg using three revolute joints, however, this paper presents a design that uses a linear actuator and revolute joints on each leg. This helps in reducing the load on motors and enhances the payload carrying capacity as the linear actuators take the major load. This paper work also includes simulation using software and hardware implementation to develop a control strategy for efficient and smooth leg motion considering factors like the robot's weight, gaiting, balance and speed.

articleTitle: Action Recognition Algorithm Exploration Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Basketball technology's action recognition algorithm is crucial, though it encounters inaccuracies in performance positioning. The conventional ant colony algorithm doesn't resolve these recognition challenges effectively. Consequently, a genetic algorithm tailored to this domain is proposed for enhancement. Initially, the theory of biological evolution identifies influential factors, segmenting indicators to minimize disruptive influences in the action recognition process. Subsequently, a genetic algorithm-driven solution for action recognition is devised and its outcomes are rigorously analyzed. MATLAB simulations demonstrate that, under specific evaluation criteria, the genetic algorithm surpasses the standard ant colony approach in accuracy and processing time for action recognition variables.

articleTitle: Classification of Deep Fake Audio Using MFCC Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Voice forgery, often made possible by advanced generative models, is becoming a bigger problem in today's digital world. There's a urgent demand for a better way to spot AI-generated voices. Our research presents a new method for detecting fake audio by combining advanced signal processing and deep learning techniques. We analyzed a dataset containing both real and fake audio samples by extracting Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) to understand the sound patterns. Using sophisticated neural networks like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Fully Connected Layers, we examined voice samples on a large scale. Through systematic testing, we identified the most effective models for distinguishing real from fake audio. Our system includes a user-friendly interface for easy audio upload and analysis. This research advances audio forensics and helps combat the spread of deepfake content online.

articleTitle: Chest X-ray Based Pulmonary Disease Classification Using Transfer Learning and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Pneumonia and Tuberculosis (TB) are the life threatening diseases caused by viral or bacterial infection of the lungs and leads to the severe abnormality of the lungs. Pneumonia infected people, who have direct contact with those having TB are at the highest risk of contracting pulmonary pneumonia tuberculosis. Early diagnosis of the pneumonia avoids the development of TB in the lungs by infection. Therefore, early diagnosis of the diseases results in successful treatment of the disease caused to the patient. Chest X-ray is the most commonly used medical imaging technique to identify the pulmonary diseases. However, lack of radiologists and pulmonologists reduces the applicability of the technique. To overcome such issues, non clinical methods such as machine learning and deep learning techniques plays a vital role in classification of pulmonary diseases. In this work, classification and prediction of pulmonary diseases using Transfer learning and CNN is proposed. The experimentation is performed by using Chest X-ray database for the classification of two types of diseases namely Pneumonia and Tuberculosis further also identify the normal lung. The proposed work is faster and employs multi-class classifier viz. transfer learning and CNN for the lung diseases classification. The MobilenetV2 transfer learning technique outer performs than convolutional neural networks. The MobilenetV2 achieved a promising performance with an accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Detection of Seizures Through Pre-Ictal Phase Using Optimized 1D-Capsule Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: A neurological illness that causes unexpected seizures, epilepsy affects millions of people worldwide. Seizure prediction and therapy greatly depend on the early identification of preictal (before seizure) and interictal (between seizures) EEG signals. In this paper, a unique deep learning architecture called 1D-Capsule Networks for an automated recognition approach has been presented. Capsule Networks improve feature extraction and classification by maintaining spatial links in EEG data, in contrast to conventional CNN models. The Greylag Goose optimizer, which is known for its effectiveness in managing complex neural network topologies, has been employed to optimize the 1D-Capsule Network model. This method is validated using a Children's Hospital Boston dataset, and our results show that it can effectively separate interictal and preictal EEG patterns. The suggested approach attains a high accuracy of 98% and offers perceptions into the temporal dynamics of seizure onset. This discovery shows potential for enhancing the treatment of epilepsy through its innovation in seizure prediction systems.

articleTitle: Predicting App Ratings on Google Play Store: An Ensemble Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: As the Google Play Store continues to burgeon with millions of mobile applications catering to diverse needs and preferences, app developers face the challenge of understanding and predicting user satisfaction and ratings. Accurately predicting app ratings is crucial for developers to optimize their app's features, user experience, and overall performance. In this study, we present a comprehensive approach to predicting app ratings on the Google Play Store using machine learning techniques. Utilizing a rich dataset encompassing app metadata such as category, size, price, number of downloads, user reviews, and historical ratings, we employ various machine learning algorithms including regression models, decision trees, random forests, and gradient boosting. Feature engineering techniques are applied to extract useful insights and enhance the models to predict.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Diagnosis of Speech Disorders: An In-Depth Investigation into Dysarthria Classification Using the ResNet18 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research article concentrates on dysarthria, a speech impediment commonly observed in individuals with conditions such as cerebral palsy (CP) or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Early detection of dysarthria is essential for effective interventions and improved patient outcomes, as it significantly impacts communication abilities. Employing the TORGO database, comprising 2000 samples from individuals with and without dysarthria, encompassing diverse genders, the study utilizes a Convolutional Neural Network (ResNet18 Model) for speech classification. The dataset encompasses both dysarthric and non-dysarthric subjects of both genders, with 500 samples each, recorded in separate sessions. The ResNet18 Model-based approach demonstrates an impressive 96% accuracy in distinguishing between dysarthric and non-dysarthric instances, underscoring the potential of deep learning technology in aiding early dysarthria detection and facilitating timely interventions. This investigation significantly contributes to advancing diagnostic capabilities and presents a promising avenue to enhance the quality of life for individuals grappling with speech difficulties.

articleTitle: Realization of 8× 10Gbps WDM System Incorporating Distinct Optical Modulators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: A high capacity 8×10Gbps wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system with long reach fiber link is realized in this work. System performance is evaluated for district modulators as well as varied transmission range and data traffic. Simulation results indicate that faithful transmission range of 0-90km can be achieved for mach-zehnder modulator at 80Gbps data traffic as compared to electroabsorption as well as single drive MZM modulators. Additionally, the fiber range can be extended upto 50-70km with 5-15Gbps throughput. Also, the eye patterns depict the optical performance of the system for varied fiber range utilizing MZM. This work illustrates best results as compared to existing works.

articleTitle: Design a 8×10Gbps WDM-WOC System using Distinct Input Sources in Visible Range
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: A 8×10Gbps wavelength division multiplexing with wireless optical communication (WDM-WOC) system incorporating distinct input sources in 380-700nm visible range is realized. The system performance is evaluated for varied range at 80Gbps throughput for input power of 5 and 10dBm. Simulation results indicate that best performance can be obtained for high input power of 10dBm followed by 5dBm and offers maximum range of 380-400km and 270-400km respectively, at 80Gbps throughput. The obtained eye patterns illustrate the optimum system performance at 10dBm input power from 250-400km than system at 5dBm power. The received power of -18 to -30dBm can be realized over 200-400km range at 10dBm input power. Moreover, this design is better than others existing ones.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band Miniaturised Wearable Antenna at 433 MHz and 915 MHz
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper proposes a wearable planar dual-band antenna that is ultra-minimized for uses in biotelemetry applications. With a tiny volume of 0.000000384, the suggested antenna covers the bands for Industry, Science, and Medicine (ISM) at 433 MHz and 915 MHz. To accomplish downsizing, the antenna is made up of a flowing line above side of the substrate and an inductive grid structure loaded on the back. Furthermore, there is a big advantage to the antenna's lack of vias in terms of making the fabrication process simpler. The incorporation of additional elements of the architecture at the device level is taken into account in the design methodology. As soon as the antenna is positioned on the various human anatomy parts, such the hand and head, it performs steadily. The assessed specific absorption rate (SAR) conforms to the prescribed standards for human safety.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Recognition and Translation Model Based on Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The translation model design is critical in intelligent recognition of English translation, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Digital mining algorithm is unable to address the translation model issue in intelligent recognition of English translation, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Fuzzy algorithm-based design of intelligent recognition English translation model is provided, and the design of intelligent recognition English translation model is assessed. To begin, the fuzzy logic theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the translation model design's needs to decrease interference factors in the translation model design. The fuzzy logic theory is then used to create a Fuzzy algorithm translation model design scheme, and the outcomes of the translation model design are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Fuzzy algorithm outperforms the standard Digital mining algorithm in terms of translation model design accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: An Efficient Convolutional Neural Network Model for Multiclass Rice Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In India as well as in other countries around the world, rice is the main staple food. Along with the increase in global population, the demand for rice production has also rapidly increased. It is currently very challenging to ensure that the complete population has access to enough food. The production of rice is also reducing due to various kinds of rice leaf diseases. These diseases can cause countries and farmers to suffer large financial losses which directly impacts the global economy. The objective of the proposed work is to reduce and early predict rice leaf diseases. This will lead to an increase in rice production resulting in securing the income source of the farmers and encouraging sustainable economic growth. The CNN model has been employed in this article to categorize the rice leaf disease. A dataset containing 9 different classes of rice leaf diseases and a healthy leaf has been collected from Kaggle. The leaf disease classes include blast, hispa, dead-heart, tungro, brown spot, bacterial_leaf_blight, downy_mildew, and bacterial_leaf-streak. To estimate the performance accuracy of the suggested model, this model has been adjusted and implemented on a range of epoch values. The results have identified that the model exhibits the highest accuracy and least loss during the training and validation stages when the epoch value has been set to 15. The accuracy and loss in the training phase using epoch 15 are 97.11% and 0.0886, respectively, whereas, on the validation side the accuracy of 92.98% and loss of 0.2321 have been identified.

articleTitle: Design of Foreign Language Learning System Platform Based on Network Text
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Under the background of rapid development of high technology, it has become a trend to use scientific and technological means to promote the efficient development of foreign language learning. The purpose is to better adapt to the current development trend, create an intelligent foreign language learning environment and improve the professional level of foreign language learning. In the process of foreign language learning, it is very important to collect, analyze and process information related to organisms, which helps to realize the specialization of foreign language learning. However, sorting algorithms can't accurately collect and analyze information in foreign language learning. Therefore, this paper proposes a network-based algorithm to analyze the system platform. Firstly, this paper uses computer technology to collect information from the Internet, and classifies the indexes according to the requirements of the system platform, so as to reduce the interference factors in the platform. Then, computer technology constructs a scheme for foreign language learning system platform, and makes a comprehensive analysis of the platform results. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the network algorithm for foreign language learning is superior to the recursive algorithm in terms of accuracy and reliability of the system platform.

articleTitle: Design, Development and Comparison of Hybrid Approaches for DNA Promoter Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research aims to devise a mechanism for promoter identification with enhanced accuracy for advancing our understanding of gene regulation and supporting applications in biotechnology, medical research, therapeutic development and genetic engineering. Multiple hybrid models such as Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) with Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU) named as DNA-Conv-GRU, CNN with Long Short-Term Mem-ory(LSTM) named as DNA-Conv-LSTM and CNN with Bidirectional LSTM(Bi-LSTM) named as DNA-Conv-Bi-LSTM were developed as part of this research. The efficiency of these models were compared in identifying preprocessed promoters and non-promoters for the species - plants and escherichia coli (e. coli). Among the three hybrid models, highest testing accuracy was achieved using DNA-Conv-Bi-LSTM. A testing accuracy of 95.97 percent for plants and 96.28 percent for e. coli were obtained using DNA-Conv-Bi-LSTM.

articleTitle: Predicting Health Insurance Claim Amount through Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Using medical cost data, this paper seeks to predict the cost of health insurance claim amount. The aim is to create an appropriate machine learning model for predicting insurance claim amount and calculate individuals' out-of-pocket expenses. This study proposes Machine Learning approaches to predict health insurance claim amount through Random Forest Regression, Multiple Linear Regression, XG Boost Regression, Gradient Boosting Regression, and Decision Tree Regression and the experimental results have demonstrated efficacy in making accurate predictions. Random Forest has a remarkable with 96.7% accuracy compared with other models.

articleTitle: Bilingual Approach: Leveraging Deep Neural Network Techniques for Handwritten Signature Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In an era defined by technological innovation, the importance of robust authentication mechanisms cannot be overstated, particularly in the realm of security management. Handwritten signature recognition stands as a pivotal component in identity verification processes. Our system harnesses the power of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to extract intricate hierarchical features from signature images, effectively capturing both global and local patterns with remarkable precision. To assess and confirm the effectiveness of our algorithm in distinguishing genuine signatures from fraudulent ones, we carefully compile datasets containing both new and existing signatures. Additionally, our work introduces an offline human signature system, underpinned by the sophisticated Histogram Equalization method, further augmenting the robustness of our approach. Our approach, which is based on research utilised in the educational system, is very helpful in protecting and validating academic documents. The addition of bilingual features increases the usefulness of our system by supporting a variety of linguistic signatures that are frequently seen in educational materials. This method guarantees a thorough and flexible solution for handwritten signature authentication in security and educational institutions.

articleTitle: Design of Human Resource Management System Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in the design of human resource management system, a design scheme of resource management system based on ant colony algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the colony foraging theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the ant colony algorithm is used to construct the design scheme of the resource management system. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of the design accuracy of the resource management system and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The design of resource management system plays an extremely important role in human resources, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of human resources. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving resource management simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, a resource management system design scheme based on ant colony algorithm is proposed to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors were accurately located through the swarm foraging theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the ant colony algorithm was used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on ant colony algorithm in the design of human resource management system can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Bp Neural Network Research on Enterprise Marketing Strategy Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Marketing is a very important part of a business. In the choice and reasonable combination of marketing strategies, it has a great role in customer choice of enterprises. Ordinary marketing strategies should not be able to adapt to the current market, and technological developments have brought new options for marketing. Therefore, this paper proposes a marketing strategy combination under BP neural network to analyze the combination of innovative marketing strategy. First of all, artificial intelligence is used to analyze and optimize marketing strategies, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of marketing strategy portfolio to reduce them Interference factors in the mix of marketing strategies. Then, artificial intelligence can form the optimal solution of the marketing strategy combination of the enterprise, form the marketing strategy combination scheme, and combine the results of the marketing strategy Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the marketing strategy combination under BP neural network is reasonable for the marketing strategy combination of enterprise market The feasibility of the combination of sex and marketing strategies is better than that of ordinary marketing strategies.

Author Keywords: Marketing strategy combination under BP neural network

articleTitle: Real-Time Caption Generation for the American Sign Language Using YOLO and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The lack of captions available for live video events on online platforms makes them inaccessible to the speech and hearing deprived communities. In this study, we examine two models: the pre-trained You Only Look Once (YOLO) framework and a Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model that uses the Mediapipe framework from Google. The LSTM model is constructed by extracting the landmark features of the subjects face, torso and hands from the video frames and using them to predict the depicted gesture. This sets it apart from existing deep learning methods that use only a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework to extract spatial features. We evaluate the performance and demonstrate the superiority of the proposed model against a LRCN model using our custom dataset. The proposed model offers a valuable approach to making live videos accessible to both viewers and speakers of the disabled community, who are currently depending on human translators. The ability to extract keypoints beforehand further enhances the models capabilities and speed.

articleTitle: LNA Design for Low Noise and High Performance in 180nm Cadence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design and implementation of Inductive Source Degeneration Low Noise Amplifier circuit for RF receiver applications using Cadence Virtuoso tool. The goal is to maximize gain(S21) while minimizing noise figure(NF) to improve the RF receiver system's overall performance and sensitivity. Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) is an essential part of the signal chain, liable for boosting weak entering signals with the least amount of extra noise. The suggested LNA circuit optimizes the trade-off between gain and noise figure by using an active biasing Cascode arrangement. To achieve effective integration with contemporary RF systems, the design makes use of cutting-edge CMOS technology. To increase the properties of gain and bandwidth, inductive source degeneration technique is used, and feedback techniques are used to improve stability. The proposed LNA shows the measured results including a 19.10dB high gain(S21), a 1.01dB noise figure(NF) and a 3.289 stability (Kf) at 2.4 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: FUZZY AHP and TOPSIS Approach to Evaluate the Criteria of HVAC Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Effective control of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems is necessary to optimize indoor comfort, energy efficiency, and environmental impact. This study presents a novel method that combines the Technique for Order of Preferences by Similar to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) with the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to improve decision-making in HVAC control systems. Conventional HVAC control systems may not be well-suited to dynamic and uncertain situations since they frequently rely on deterministic algorithms and preset rules. On the other hand, the suggested method makes use of fuzzy logic to address the innate ambiguity and imprecision in HVAC control choices. reducing the impact on the environment and energy use.

articleTitle: Tire Recommendation System for Maximum Space Utilisation of Cargo Container
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Efficiently utilizing cargo container space is a critical concern in modern logistics, particularly in the context of tire loading where theoretical calculations often lead to inefficient space utilization. In this work, we not only address the challenge of optimizing container space utilization for tire loading but also include the recommendation of additional loading of tires in a preloaded container to maximize utilization of container space. We employ a variety of algorithms, including Greedy, Heuristic (Genetic Algorithm), Metaheuristic (Ant Colony Optimization, Particle Swarm Optimization, Iterated Local Search), Integer Linear Programming (ILP), Constraint Programming (CP), and Machine Learning-based recommendation systems. Our work provides valuable insights into optimizing logistics operations and minimizing resource wastage. It promises to streamline transportation logistics, minimize inefficiencies in loading procedures, and contribute to a more sustainable and cost-efficient supply chain.

articleTitle: Smart Service Methods and Systems Based on Innovation and Entrepreneurship Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's rapid development of high technology, the use of scientific and technological means to make the development of innovation and entrepreneurship platform better has made a trend, in order to more adapt to the current development, create a smart innovation and entrepreneurship platform, so that the efficiency of the innovation and entrepreneurship platform is improved, and the innovation and entrepreneurship platform follows. In the innovation and entrepreneurship platform, it is very important to collect, analyze and process the information of the living organisms in the innovation and entrepreneurship platform, so as to achieve the efficient realization of the innovation and entrepreneurship platform. Iterative algorithms cannot accurately collect and analyze information problems in innovation and entrepreneurship platforms. Therefore, this paper proposes a data fusion algorithm for intelligent service methods and system analysis. First, computer technology is used to collect Internet information, and indicators is divided according to smart service methods and system requirements to reduce interference factors in smart service methods and systems. Then, computer technology forms the smart service method and system scheme of the innovation and entrepreneurship platform smart service method and system results, and comprehensively analyzes the smart service method and system results. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the data fusion algorithm is better than the iterative algorithm for the intelligent service method and system accuracy, smart service method and system reliability of the innovation and entrepreneurship platform.

articleTitle: Acoustic Based Bird Species Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper uses deep learning techniques to present a novel approach for acoustic-based bird species classification. Leveraging a dataset comprising 10,955 audio samples from six distinct bird species, we extracted diverse features, including chroma, spectrogram, and MFCCs. These features were stacked to form input tensors of size 48x128x1, subsequently fed into a CNN architecture. Our model achieved a commendable accuracy of 0.81 in classifying bird species, demonstrating the efficacy of the proposed methodology. This research contributes to bioacoustics and avian ecology by offering a reliable tool for automated bird species identification, which holds promise for various applications, including biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts.

articleTitle: Light Intensity Analysis And Prediction For Dharana Using LabView
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's distracted world, Dharana practice offers a solution to sharpen focus and concentration. This study explores the relationship between concentration and the intensity of light emitted by a diya. By analyzing the intensity of light, the duration of focus can be enhanced. Various oils are tested with diya light, and their intensities and pixel values are measured to determine the most effective for concentration. Logistic regression is employed to train a model, which provides reviews on oils based on their intensity values. Unlike conventional color-based methods, this approach focuses on light analysis, incorporating HSI and RGB luminance. LabVIEW's Vision Acquisition module facilitates image processing for accurate analysis. Ultimately, this research aims to optimize Dharana practice by selecting the most suitable oil to mitigate distractions and improve focus.

articleTitle: EEG Controlled Robotic Arm Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper presents an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-controlled robotic arm system designed to establish a direct interface between human brain signals and precise robotic arm movements. The study begins with the derivation of kine-matic models to understand the spatial dynamics of the robotic arm. Following a systematic methodology, the EEG data undergo preprocessing, training using an optimizable KNN model and an optimizable tree model, and integration with a Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC), addressing uncertainties in neural signal inter-pretation. Simulation results demonstrate the system's efficacy in accurately interpreting neural signals and executing movements based on user intents. The robust integration of machine learning algorithms and a Fuzzy Logic Controller validates the seamless translation of raw EEG data into precise control commands.

articleTitle: An Efficient Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average Model for AAPL, MSFT, NTFX, and GOOGL Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Stock market prediction is an important facet of financial analysis since it affects the investment decisions. This study employs the AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model to predict the future price movements of four prominent technology stocks: The abovementioned companies include Apple Inc. (AAPL), Microsoft Corporation (MSFT), Netflix Inc. ARIMA model is a steady time series forecasting process that introduced the autoregressive, differencing and moving average components for capturing temporal patterns in stock price data. The study presents the data collection and preprocessing, model selection, training end evaluation steps. The historical stock price data, trading volumes and relevant financial indicators are then collected from records which includes the processing of information in terms of quality control as well as stationarity. The study focuses on choosing proper parameters for the three hyperparameters (p, d and q) of ARIMA model via rigorous analysis of autocorrelation plot along with partial correlation plot as well Akaike Information Criterion AIC & Bayesian Information Criterion BIC. The chosen models are trained on a subset of historical data, and their performance is measured using metrics including Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Root Mean Square error(RMSE). The aim of this study is to shed light on the accuracy and efficiency of ARIMA model for stock prices forecasting AAPL, MSFT, NFLX & GOOGL in a given time frame. Although aware of the fundamental difficulties and limitations in stock market prediction, this study seeks to offer perspectives on using time series forecasting techniques for better decision-making within an uncertain environment such as financial markets. The results and conclusions of this study are relevant for investors, traders, financial analysts as well as researchers who believe in the use of quantitative methods to obtain an overview on stock market patterns and make evidence-based investment decisions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Resource Management through Deep Learning: A Predictive Analytics Approach to Employee Retention Success
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research explores the integration of deep learning in Human Resource Management (HRM) to increase the accuracy of predictive modeling in successful hiring and retention. It should be noted that HR data is very complex and so most traditional analytical methods usually fall short of providing accurate forecasts that are integral for management-level decision-making. This research introduces two deep learning models: a deep neural network (DNN) for an employee turnover prediction together with a CNN for NLP use cases for recruitment success assessment. A model's performance is assessed through accuracy, area under the curve (AUC), mean absolute error (MAE), and root mean square error (RMSE) metrics which are carried out by the study using the datasets that comprise various HR metrics. The study reveals that the DNN model reaches 92% and 0.94 respectively in the accuracy and AUC parameters for employee retention predictions, whereas the convolutional neural network (CNN) model gives an accuracy of 95% and 0.97 in proving recruitment success. These outperform the accuracy of various predictive analytics techniques, demonstrating DLLM's capability to transform HRM practices by using high-precision analytics in managing human capital. This study adds to the literature by demonstrating beyond a doubt deep learning as a utility and a fact in HRM, but at the same time, offering practical insights that can be harnessed by HR professionals to use the same for high-yield data-driven HM decisions. Moreover, this area covers the ethical issues and inherent biases that are involved in using AI in HR. Implementing responsible AI in this domain is strongly recommended. The present study has great implications for the whole debate about the integration of AI into HR strategies. The study shows how HR procedures can be greatly enhanced by the article. The future research agenda will involve establishing the applicability of these AI models in various industries as well as investigating the associated long-term consequences of AI-powered HRM.

articleTitle: Decoding Abnormal Heart Patterns: ECG Anomaly Detection Using MobileNet50 CNN Autoencoder Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In this research investigation, the application of Convolutional Neural Network (MobileN et50) Autoencoders is explored for the detection of anomalies in electrocardiogram (ECG) data using the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database. The dataset comprises 14,552 samples categorized into normal heartbeats and those affected by cardiac abnormalities. The incorporation of Transposed Convolution significantly improves the model's performance. The study underscores the timely recognition of cardiac abnormalities and introduces a specialized MobileNet50 Autoencoder model designed to efficiently encode and decode ECG data, aiding in the identification of irregular patterns. The methodology involves constructing a robust Autoencoder with encoder and decoder components trained to minimize reconstruction errors. Evaluation metrics showcase the model's outstanding accuracy (76.93%), precision (55.23%), recall (89.81%), and F1 score (65.40%). This research underscores the importance of leveraging deep learning techniques for early anomaly detection in ECG data, presenting a promising avenue for enhancing diagnostic capabilities and ultimately benefiting patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Control of Solar and Wind Battery Storage Based Micro Grid Using Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Solar energy storage microgrids have emerged as a crucial solution in the shift towards sustainable energy systems. This handbook offers insights into leveraging simulation tools and methodologies for the design, optimization, and deployment of control mechanisms within solar photovoltaic storage-based microgrids. Emphasizing their role in enhancing grid reliability and promoting renewable energy utilization, the guide underscores the complexity of microgrid management. A holistic understanding of factors such as renewable energy generation, energy storage, demand patterns, and grid interactions is essential. Simulation techniques play a pivotal role in refining and validating control algorithms, facilitating the cost-effective and secure operation of solar PV storage microgrids prior to real-world implementation. Leveraging advanced simulation platforms empowers stakeholders to make informed decisions regardingmicrogrid design, operation, and investment, thereby fostering the seamless integration of renewable energy sources and promoting energy independence on local and global scales. This synopsis underscores the significance of simulation as a critical tool for enhancing the management of solar photovoltaic storage microgrids.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Parallel Power Supply Hardware Platform of Intelligent and Regulated Switching Power Supply Module Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the realm of parallel-powered intelligent, regulated switching power modules, the significance of a hardwired platform structure cannot be understated. However, this approach often grapples with imprecision in result evaluation. PAC falls short in addressing these structural issues within such parallel power configurations, revealing inherent flaws. To address this, we introduce an analysis leveraging a microcontroller to dissect the architecture of the hardwired platform in question. Initially, the analog circuit theory is employed to design the switching power supply. Based on the specific needs of the hardwired platform, metrics are segmented to minimize disruptions during platform assembly. Subsequently, using analog circuit principles, a parallel arrangement's hardwired platform for the intelligent, regulated power module is devised, establishing a comprehensive blueprint for the hardwired setup. A thorough examination of the constructed platform's outcomes is then conducted. MATLAB simulations confirm that, adhering to set construction benchmarks, the microcontroller-driven connection of the power module to the parallel-configured power supply outperforms PAC in terms of construction precision and duration for the hardwired platform.

Author Keywords: Intelligent regulated switching power supply module parallel power supply hardwired

articleTitle: Application Research on Overhead Line Phenomenon Based on Online Video Stream Calculation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The research into phenomenon application is crucial for overhead lines, but it encounters issues with incorrect performance placement. The traditional Circuit examination method fails to solve the research problem in overhead lines and produces inadequate outcomes. Therefore, an online video stream computational analysis-based investigation of overhead line phenomenon is offered, and the phenomenon application research is evaluated. Initially, the dataset theory is employed to identify the influential factors, and the indicators are categorized according to the requirements of the phenomenon application research to minimize interference in the investigation. Subsequently, the dataset theory is used to devise an online video streaming computational analysis scheme for phenomenon application research, and the findings are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results indicate that, under specific evaluation criteria, the online video streaming computational analysis surpasses the conventional Circuit inspection approach in terms of accuracy and timeliness of influence variables in phenomenon application research.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of NN Controller based EV Charging Station with Enhanced Power Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This project involved developing and analyzing an energy-efficient electric vehicle (EV) station, utilizing a neural network controller. The station is capable of standalone operation and utilizes electricity from a photovoltaic array to charge EV batteries, while also offering power connectivity to electrical equipment. Additionally, it facilitates energy reimbursement, enhancing the electricity grid's quality. The EV station fulfills several functions, including current charging, EV battery management, simultaneous charging and settlement, as well as payment processing. It is engineered to function smoothly even during grid conflicts, ensuring grid compliance of less than 5% as per IEEE-519 standards. A neural network-based topology control scheme is implemented to optimize energy efficiency by comparing physical activities. Moreover, synchronous control is integrated to enable grid connectivity whenever feasible.

articleTitle: Demultiplexer Power Management: Strategies for Enhancing Energy Efficiency and Thermal Stability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper presents a study of energy-efficient demultiplexer design on FPGA platforms in response to the growing energy demands in communication systems. We achieve significant power consumption reductions without compromising functionality or performance by examining power, temperature, input/output resource utilization, and creative circuit optimizations. Through extensive testing and prototyping, data demonstrates significant energy savings for developing green communication technologies. Also found that Artix board consumed less power than the Virtex board.

articleTitle: YOLOv4-Powered Traffic Intelligence: From Detection to Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The Traffic Analysis System utilizes machine learning for real-time traffic insights at a junction. It provides instant stats like vehicle count, density, and FPS, while summarizing average vehicle crossings, densities, stop times, and identifying peak minutes. Machine learning techniques include object detection, tracking, and lane segmentation. The system offers a user-friendly interface with graphical representations, aiding traffic management decisions. It not only ensures efficient traffic control but also allows for predictive analytics and potential integration with traffic light systems for adaptive signal adjustments. Continuous model training and future enhancements promise improved accuracy and adaptability to evolving traffic scenarios.

articleTitle: A Novel Cyclone Detection System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Cyclones as natural disasters, pose significant threats to human life and property, necessitating precise and timely cyclone detection systems. Traditional detection approaches have limitations in accuracy and speed, resulting in potential delays in issuing early warnings. In response to the challenges posed by traditional detection methods, this research introduces an innovative Cyclone Detection System (CDS) that leverages machine learning and deep learning algorithms to significantly enhance cyclone detection efficiency and reliability. The CSD integrates diverse meteorological data sources to construct a comprehensive and multi-dimensional feature set. This feature set aims to capture the intricate and dynamic patterns associated with cyclone formation and development. Advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks and Recurrent Neural Networks, are employed to process the feature set and accurately classify cyclonic patterns. The deep learning models utilized in the CDS facilitate automatic learning and adaptation to evolving cyclone characteristics, greatly improving its detection capabilities. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed system, extensive experiments were conducted using historical cyclone datasets. The results affirm the superiority of the CDS over traditional methods, achieving significantly higher accuracy i.e. 92% in cyclone detection. Furthermore, the real-time implementation of the CDS ensures swift detection and monitoring of cyclones, enabling the timely issuance of early warnings to vulnerable regions. By providing precise and timely information, this groundbreaking CDS has the potential to save lives, mitigate property damage, and enhance disaster response coordination.

articleTitle: DL based Heart Disease Prediction System using CT Scan Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Deep learning (DL) holds a crucial role in medical imaging, with rapid integration into AI for diagnostics. Despite widespread use in medical research, DL encounters limitations in practical clinical diagnosis, particularly in efficient medical image analysis. Focusing on the diagnosis of cardiovascular disease (CVD) using AI and DL for predictive analysis from CT scan images, this article emphasizes the need for methodological development. It highlights the existing gap between DL's potential and its practical implementation in clinical settings. In the context of CVD diagnostics, the study addresses modular elements of DL, encompassing image classification, segmentation, and detection. The research identifies challenges arising from this paradigm shift and proposes solutions, paving the way for pre-operative computerized simulation planning and the application of suitable surgical intervention technologies.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) - Disease Prediction Using CT Scan Images - DensetNet121 model - Inception V3 model - CT Scan Analysis - AI in Healthcare

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation Using Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research focuses on the crucial role of the clustering technique in data mining, specifically in market forecasting and planning. The study presents a comprehensive report on utilizing the k-means clustering technique and data visualization tools to develop a real- time system for a supermarket, predicting sales across various annual cycles. An open-source dataset of a mall with n = 200 customers divided into k = 3 groups, demonstrated high accuracy in predicting day-to-day sales statistics when compared with actual results. The research highlights the effectiveness of the clustering technique in real-time sales prediction for supermarkets.

articleTitle: Advanced Power Quality in Hybrid PV-Wind Systems with TSK Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Off-grid setups struggle to keep power flowing steadily, especially at night and when wind speeds vary. To tackle this, a mix of solar panels, wind power using a special generator, and a battery form a new kind of power grid called a Microgrid. Since both solar and wind make DC power, a converter joins them onto one line and manages their output. Then, this combined line connects to regular electric devices through an inverter, making it easy to use with existing power systems. This work proposes a method for microgrid controlling that makes use of Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy control devices to guarantee that users receive quality electricity. The proposed controller maintains stable voltage levels for both AC and DC loads during disturbances, thereby enhancing power quality by minimizing total harmonic distortion and frequency fluctuations. Moreover, it facilitates power balance by regulating the flow between the battery and the system. The system's performance is assessed using MATLAB modeling and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation with OPAL-RT modules.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Solution for Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The novel technique to diabetic retinopathy (DR) detection is the main emphasis of this work. With the use of a specially designed Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on a carefully chosen dataset. It was possible to accurately classify whether DR is present. A well-designed CNN architecture and meticulous preprocessing go a long way toward the model's excellent performance. Real-time DR forecasts are made possible by the research's innovative creation of an intuitive online application. The model's efficacy is demonstrated by evaluation on a different test set, underscoring its potential for early DR detection in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an AI and IoT-Enabled Smart Safety Helmet for Real-Time Environmental and Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research paper is introducing the concept of AI and IoT-enabled Smart Safety Helmet for Real-Time Environmental and Health Monitoring, which is a breakthrough attempt focusing on providing safety solutions for workers in dangerous areas. Employing the AI-IoT synergy to solve the problem of monitoring the surrounding environment and the mental state of the user, our helmet significantly decreases a risk of an accident and exposure to dangerous conditions. The primary part of the study is to mount various sensors on the helmet so as to observe the realtime changes in the environmental parameters that include CO2 levels, temperature, humidity, and physical responses of the wearer as well. This sensor data is then fed into a microcontroller unit that is connected with IoT that uses this process and analyze the data to identify risks and assess risk levels. Through the IoT technology, a perfect channel for a real-time data transfer to the end-users end the centralized monitoring systems is availed, enabling an action to be taken immediately. We ran many different types of MATLAB simulations and real-world testing scenarios. Then our evaluation determined the sensors' accuracy, the efficiency of the AI model, the consumption of the power, the data transmission capabilities, and the overall usability of the helmet. This outcome not only confirms the safety and economical nature of the helmet but as well its user-centricity design which ensures its effectiveness in creating a safe working environment.

articleTitle: 6G: Enabling the Future of Healthcare Delivery
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This article investigates how the ultra-high bandwidth, ultra-low latency, and huge machine-type communication capabilities of 6G technology could transform the way healthcare is delivered. It talks about how 6G can support cutting-edge uses like real-time medical data analysis, interactive healthcare experiences, and remote surgery. The article also discusses important issues including security, privacy, and ethical ramifications of incorporating 6G into healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Insights: Evaluating the Efficacy of CNN-SVM for Accurate Kidney Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research aims to examine and evaluate a system that utilizes a CNN and SVM to categorize renal diseases into two unique categories. The model was built using a dataset of 4,500 X-ray pictures that are available to the general public. According to the study results, it seems that the CNN-SVM model demonstrates greater performance in all areas. The model's recall rate of 93.02%, accuracy rate of 90.91%, and F1 score of 91.95% provide evidence of its effectiveness in addressing individuals diagnosed with renal illness. These results provide proof that it can accurately detect genuine affirmative identity papers and decrease the occurrence of false positives. Previous iterations have also shown the consistent efficacy of the paradigm in people without renal disease. The model consistently achieved an F1 score of 92.47%, a recall rate of 91.49%, and an accuracy rate of 93.48%. This indicates that the model is very proficient at identifying individuals in the population who are in excellent health. The CNN-SVM model successfully distinguished between patients with chronic renal failure and healthy control participants by analyzing medical photos of persons afflicted with kidney disease.

articleTitle: GHI Prediction Based on Weather Data Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The proposed model aims to predict Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) by using various environmental factors and several Machine Learning algorithms like Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Random Forest, Long Short Term Memory(LSTM), Support Vector Machine(SVM), and Light Gradient Boosting Machine(GBM). The dataset is preprocessed, and relevant features are selected for the model. The linear regression model is implemented using gradient descent to optimize the weights and bias without importing it from Python libraries. The cost function is minimized over multiple epochs, and the convergence is visualized. The trained model is then used to make predictions on a test set. Several performance metrics, such as MSE, RMSE, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{R}^{2}$</tex>, are calculated to evaluate the model's accuracy. The code combines data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation, providing a comprehensive overview of the predictive modeling process for solar irradiance.

articleTitle: The Allocation of Channels Within Cognitive Radio Based Smart Grid Using RHGO with Deep Q Probabilistic Procedure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Compared to conventional electricity grids, Smart Grids have advanced features more as a result of smart communications. The cognitive radio sensor networks (CRSNs) are being used to make up the increased demands for quality of services in Smart Grids. The majority of currently applied techniques are not enough to fulfil the spectrum demand of users, which results in data transmission delays. Therefore, this rock hyraxes group optimization (RHGO) built on deep Q-probabilistic procedure is suggested in this study to enhance the allocation of channels in CRSN Smart Grids. The Q-table is located within the sink nodes that store the users' IDs. The channels send request to user IDs. The RHGO selects the highly prioritized user from the Q-table after searching for the initial demanded users. According to the users' requests, deep probabilistic neural networks (DPNNs) find the unoccupied channel. According to the active and sleeping period, the DPNNs search for unoccupied channels. By utilizing DPNNs, the suggested technique enhances the allocation of channels while taking less time. This study applies the MATLAB program to accomplish the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Intelligent Framework to Detection of Fake News Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the vast realm of social media, the insidious spread of fake news has become an unsettling reality, blurring the lines between fact and fiction. Misleading narratives and fabricated stories on social platforms can sway public opinion, erode trust, and hinder informed decision-making. The swift escalation of false information through likes, shares, and retweets underscores the pressing need for media literacy and critical thinking in the digital age. Fake news not only undermines the credibility of reputable sources but also poses significant challenges to the integrity of democratic discourse and societal cohesion. To combat the menace of fake news, a collective effort is required from users, platforms, and authorities to verify, share responsibly, and uphold the truth in the online landscape. Fake news is misinformation that is spread with the intent of personal benefit. It may be political or financial gain. Fake news has even influenced public opinion to a large extent in recent years. With the negative impact created by false information on gullible people's lives, we are prompted to develop systems to takle the issue of fake news's proliferation. Through this paper, we have done a comprehensive study of existing tools and techniques and further employed classification as multi-class and binary with help of many algorithms of Machine Learning like Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression(LR) and models of Deep Learning as Convolutional Neural Network, Long Short Term Memory. By utilizing the Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm, we achieved the maximum accuracy in our experiments.

articleTitle: An Enhancing Comprehensive Machine Learning Framework for DDoS Defense Through Leveraging Multiple Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Addressing Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks involves leveraging organizational assets, particularly the website framework. Departing from prior studies relying on an outdated KDD dataset, the paper emphasizes the importance of using the latest data for a comprehensive understanding of the current DDoS landscape. Utilizing machine learning techniques, including Random Forest, k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gaussian, and Naive Bayes classification algorithms, the study introduces an amalgamated model for classifying and predicting DDoS attack types. The DDoS attack network logs dataset from GitHub and Python as a simulator were utilized. Model performance evaluation involved generating confusion matrices. In the first classification using Random Forest, Precision (PR) and Recall (RE) both reached high values, yielding an average Accuracy (AC) in a satisfactory range (81% to 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). In the second classification, PR and RE both attained notable values, resulting in an average AC within an acceptable range. The innovation lies in the construction of an integrated model that combines Random Forest, KNN, SVM, Gaussian, and Naive Bayes to enhance overall predictive performance. Notably, a significant improvement in defect determination accuracy was observed when compared to existing research. This underscores the effectiveness of the integrated model in addressing the dynamic landscape of DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: Phishing URLs Using Machine Learning Hybrid Stacking Classifier Approach with XGBoost, Random Forest and Extra Trees
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Within the dynamic field of cybersecurity threats, phishing remains a prevalent and sophisticated tactic employed by malicious actors to deceive consumers. This paper presents a novel approach that leverages the strengths of Random Forest, ExtraTrees, and XGBoost in a machine learning framework to enhance the detection of phishing URLs through a hybrid stacking classifier. The suggested method combines the best features of all three ensemble learning techniques to provide a phishing detection model that is reliable and precise. An ensemble of classifiers is formed by combining XGBoost, which is well-known for its boosting abilities, with the highly randomized ExtraTrees method and the adaptable Random Forest algorithm. By using the various decision limits of each base learner, the hybrid stacking model combines their particular capabilities in the best possible way to provide higher prediction performance. Preprocessing is done on the training dataset to extract pertinent characteristics such as content, URL structure, and contextual data. The efficacy of the suggested method in detecting phishing URLs is assessed by extensive testing on an extensive dataset. The results indicate how well the hybrid stacking classifier performs in comparison to separate classifiers and highlight the possibility for improved phishing detection in practical situations. The study has importance as it presents a novel and efficient machine learning-based approach to counteract the rising danger of phishing assaults, hence propelling the area of cybersecurity forward.

articleTitle: Innovative Innings: Exploring Cricket Shot Categories with CNN-SVM Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Automatic identification of cricket strokes is essential for preparation and training in sports analytics. A research paper presents an innovative approach to cricket shot classification. It combines convolutional neural networks (CNN) and support vector machines (SVM) to classify five specific types of cricket shots: cover drive, cut shot, pull shot, leg glaze, and straight drive. The model's performance is evaluated holistically using numerous criteria such as precision, recall, F1-score, support, support percentage, and overall accuracy. The model showed perfect accuracy, ranging from 86.91% for the cover drive to 94.29% for the straight drive, reflecting the model's ability to detect positive occurrences of each shot type accurately. The recall rates were outstanding, and the maximum rate was 97.16% for Pull Shot, which reflects the model's sensitivity in capturing the critical shots. All classes produced consistent F1 scores, which measure the balance of precision and recall. The highest of 94.38% was achieved for Pull Shot, confirming the excellent evaluation of the model's accuracy. The support proportions were computed using the support values, which provide the absolute occurrences in each class, showing the class distribution across the dataset. Each class had a support ratio ranging from about 0.19 to 0.22, with the Straight Drive class having the highest percentage of 0.22. The model obtained an excellent accuracy of 91.08%, proving its utility in all the classes. In addition to specific indicators, we summarized the general performance of the model using a few averages. The macro average that puts equal weight on all classes yielded an accuracy of 91.07%, recall of 91.35%, and F1-score of 91.11 %. Considering the class imbalance, the weighted average gave an accuracy of 91.21 %, recall of 91.08%, and F1-score of 91.04%.

articleTitle: Predicting Pet Photo Pawpularity: A Deep Learning Approach on PetFinder.my
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: PetFinder.my, a leading pet adoption platform, plays a crucial role in matching rescue animals with potential adopters. In this context, the visual appeal of pet photographs, termed “Pawpularity,” significantly influences adoption rates. This study harnesses advanced deep learning techniques to predict and enhance the Pawpularity of pet photos, aiming to boost adoption success. By utilizing a class of convolutional neural network, EfficientNet, the research integrates image features with meta-data to predict the Pawpularity scores of pet photos. Opti-mized through iterative training and validation, the model's architecture leverages pretrained networks and fine-tuning to improve prediction accuracy and reduce the loss. Preliminary results indicate that the model can successfully assess the Paw-pularity of pet images, offering insights into how specific photo characteristics affect viewer appeal. By systematically evaluating and enhancing the attractiveness of pet photos, this research contributes to increasing adoption rates, thereby advancing the welfare of rescue animals. Furthermore, the integration of image analysis and metadata evaluation in a deep learning framework presents a novel approach to understanding and enhancing the factors contributing to successful pet adoptions on PetFinder.my. However the proposed deep learning model attain the lowest RMSE of 18.9648 during model training.

articleTitle: Intelligent Weight Monitoring: A Telegram Alert System for Multi-Purpose Use in Saline Bottle Management and General Weighing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Ensuring the optimal administration of saline bottle is paramount for patient well-being. The proposed system addresses the critical need for precise saline level monitoring through the integration of advanced technology. The system converts the mechanical force of the saline bottle's weight into an electrical pulse with the help of load cell. The HX711 module processes this pulse, relaying weight data to the ESP32 micro-controller. The ESP32 calculates 50% and 80% weight values, triggering Telegram alerts upon reaching these thresholds. The prototype incorporates features such as a buzzer for alarms when the weight falls below 20%, a 4-digit seven-segment display for real-time weight visualization, a tare button for resetting current weight to zero, and a versatile function button for expanded system use. The solution makes use of the ESP32's flash memory to safely retain the initial weight data, guaranteeing manual intervention-free data recovery even in the event of a power loss. Furthermore, the device improves safety by identifying potential blockages in the IV line by means of extended intervals in which the bottle's weight does not decrease. This multipurpose, automated system greatly improves patient care protocols by streamlining saline level monitoring and providing healthcare personnel with proactive alerts and real-time data.

articleTitle: From Text to Canvas: Unleashing the Artistry of GAN-Driven Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research investigates the accuracy and loss metrics of many text-to-image synthesis models, such as VQGAN+CLIP, BigGAN, StyleGAN, SR3, Imagen, and Glide. We aim to study these models to discover their ability to develop high-quality images from textual descriptions. Models with a 95% classification accuracy or greater exhibit significant semantic coherence between text and visuals, indicating their potential to effectively depict the intended information.
