Thoroughly analyzing these metrics reveals important information about the strengths, weaknesses, and ways to enhance models for text-to-image synthesis. Research and development efforts in the field of text-to-image synthesis models are advanced by these discoveries. They serve as a roadmap for future efforts to improve these models' performance in a variety of contexts, such as multimedia synthesis, content development, and creative design. Words such as SR3, Image, Accuracy, Glide, Model evaluation, Performance metrics, Computational efficiency, and Semantic coherence are used in the index.

articleTitle: Underwater Wireless Optical Communication with MIMO Spatial Diversity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: There is an increasing need for creative solutions as the requirement for reliable underwater communication expands across multiple areas, including defense, industrial applications, and marine research. In order to improve the functionality of wireless optical communication systems submerged, this research investigates the integration of cutting-edge technology, particularly Spatial variety using Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO). Enhancing channel responsiveness and communication dependability in difficult underwater conditions is the main goal. Conventional underwater communication techniques, such acoustic communication, have drawbacks like high latency, constrained bandwidth, and noise susceptibility. UWOC uses the special properties of optical transmissions to get over some of these obstacles. In this paper, it is studied that the effectiveness of wireless optical communication devices operating underwater with quadrature amplitude modulation for multiple input and multiple output. There are some difficulties brought on by the underwater environment, including signal attenuation, scattering, and absorption. Water quality and turbidity can also affect how well optical signals work. In order to create communication systems that work, these issues must be resolved. The effects of these difficulties are considered in this analysis. It is obtained that the bit error rate (BER) for both single input and single output and multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) can be obtained by selecting the optimal modulation technique among various options. The findings demonstrate how significantly spatial variety can enhance system performance, particularly in more turbulent channels and coastal water.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on ARIMA and Regression Models for Time Series Forecasting on Bitcoin Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: n the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency markets, the precise forecasting of Bitcoin's value against the US Dollar acquires paramount importance, catering to the interests of diverse stakeholders including investors, regulatory agencies, and academia. This study ventures into a comprehensive assessment of various time series forecasting methodologies, including but not limited to Random Forest Regression, ARIMA, Linear Regression, and XGBoost. Notably, our investigation unveils a pivotal revelation: the foundational models like Linear Regression and Random Forest Regression, traditionally con-sidered less complex, not only contend but also surpass the forecast accuracy of ARIMA models in the realm of Bitcoin. This paper aims to demystify the underpinnings of this superior performance, especially in mitigating the inherent volatility and unpredictability characteristic of Bitcoin. Our findings herald a transformative perspective in financial time series forecasting, potentially reshaping investment strategies and predictive analytics in the digital currency landscape.n the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency markets, the precise forecasting of Bitcoin's value against the US Dollar acquires paramount importance, catering to the interests of diverse stakeholders including investors, regulatory agencies, and academia. articleTitle: CryptoDomains: Building a Decentralized Domain Marketplace with NFTs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The proposed system introduces a decentralized platform built on the Ethereum blockchain, enabling users to acquire, trade, and utilize unique domain names as cryptographic identifiers. Leveraging the ERC-721 standard for non-fungible tokens (NFTs), the platform ensures the secure and transparent ownership of digital assets. The system integrates with the popular MetaMask wallet for user authentication, offering a seamless and widely-adopted solution. Users can mint new domains, buy existing ones, and list owned domains for sale, all facilitated by smart contracts governing domain creation, ownership transfer, and transaction execution. The architecture emphasizes security measures, such as code audits, access controls, and encryption, to safeguard user assets. The platform not only provides a novel approach to digital asset ownership but also simplifies cryptocurrency transactions by allowing users to conduct transactions using easily memorable domain names rather than complex wallet addresses. This research paper explores the technical intricacies, security considerations, and user interactions within the Crypto Domains ecosystem, contributing to the broader understanding of decentralized applications and non-fungible token platforms.

articleTitle: Quantum-Based QKD and Sugar-Salt Encryption Approach in Cloud-Fog Computing to Strengthen Protection of Online Banking Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Cloud computing is swiftly developing, delivering a diverse spectrum of computing utilities like databases, storage, and servers. It transfigures the way data storage is done and securely circulated among numerous users. Nevertheless, enabling privacy and restricting identity breaches when availing cloud utilities is essential. Fog Computing, an updated version of the cloud framework, utilizes a decentralized architecture to maintain data between the cloud and the data sources. This procedure seeks to improve performance, network connectivity, and most importantly provide security. Quantum key distribution (QKD) is employed in fog computing architectures to develop and circulate keys. The employed keys change their quantum configurations, enabling them to be highly safe. Further, an intermediary maintaining the key can identify any endeavor by illegal entities to operate it. In this research article, we utilize sugar-salt encryption, an approach designed to oppose brute-force invasions efficiently. This encryption procedure delivers erroneous data in reply to wrong password/key insertions, improving data protection, which is pivotal in online based banking data protection.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN-SVM System for Multiclass Detection of Apple Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This model has been categorized as an electronic model that is an excellent tool for discriminating between various sorts of disorders as part of our study that focuses on diagnosing illnesses in apple leaves. Healthy leaves, Apple Scab, Powdery Mildew, Cedar Apple Rust, Apple Mosaic Virus, Apple Leaf Spot, Fire Blight, and frog-eye leaf Spot are some of the eight distinct disease categories that may be seen in Apple leaves. After getting special training, this model was able to spot some illnesses. These illnesses were put into the right groups by the computer, as shown by the findings. As an example, the model was able to tell the difference between healthy leaves 93.75% of the time. It got 92.02% of the real healthy leaves right, with an F1-Score of 92.88 percentage points. On the other hand, Apple Scab got an F1-Score of 93.54 percent, with a remembering rate of 94.41% and an accuracy rate of 92.68%. The model was always very good at all kinds of sickness, with accuracy and memory rates above 92%. The mean scores for our model always stuck around 93.41%, no matter if the scores were global, weighted, or micro. This showed that the model was stable and could find diseases well. Also, the model was very accurate overall (95%), which was a great finding. The fact that the model can tell the difference among several diseases that affect apple leaves shows that our method works. By making a tool that can correctly diagnose diseases in farming settings, the results of this study will help to improve how apple crops are cared for in terms of their health.

articleTitle: Forecasting Future Trajectories in Rubber Technology Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the abstract, To achieve optimal performance and reliability, rubber product manufacturers must implement severe quality control techniques. In this paper, researchers suggest and develop a unique defect detection methodology for rubber technology that uses a combination of CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) and Random Forest algorithms. The research focuses on six unique defect types: tear-resistant deficiencies oxidation damage, pitting, hardness spots, flashing, or fisheyes/pinholes. After thorough experimentation with evaluation, our model performs exceptionally well, with accuracy ratings that vary from 95.29% to 96.22%, recall values ranging from 95.24% to 96.05%, and Fl scores ranging from 95.52% to 95.96%. These measures, together with the high support values, demonstrate the model's accuracy or robustness in defect diagnosis. Furthermore, supporting proportion analysis provides information about the distribution of cases across defect types. The total accuracy of 99% demonstrates the model's ability to correctly understand rubber problems. it suggested approach not only improves fault identification in rubber technology, but it also offers a prospective path for developing quality assurance operations, resulting in increased product reliability and lower manufacturing costs.

articleTitle: Deep Analysis: Apple Fruit Disease Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Vision systems have played an important role infruit processing lines. Integrating them in such processes improves efficiency and reduces human errors. Fruit industries are susceptible to losses due to defect detection and lack of timely measures. In this work, various defects in apples -scab, rot, blotch are considered. As a part of the dataset collection, healthy images also form part of datset. Convolution neural networks - VGG 16, VGG-19, Resnet 50, Inception, DenseNet, and MobileNet are used for the classification of 3 defects. The data augmentation methods are applied to create a balanced dataset. A total of 2000 images of the 4 categories are used for training/testing with a ratio of 80:20. The performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F-score are evaluated. It is observed that MobileNEt performs better than other models with an accuracy of 98%. The misclassifications are represented inthe confusion matrix for each model.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Parkinson's disease, a progressive neurological disorder, presents a spectrum of symptoms primarily affecting motor functions such as tremors and coordination challenges. Beyond the physical symptoms, it encroaches upon cognitive and emotional domains, often leading to depression and cognitive decline. A recent breakthrough in diagnosis involves a voice-based model that detects subtle speech irregularities linked to Parkinson's. This innovative approach relies on a dataset comprising 24 columns capturing diverse symptoms, from motor impairments to non-motor indicators. This dataset serves as a crucial foundation for training and validating the model's accuracy. By analyzing individual symptom profiles, this multidimensional approach facilitates early detection and tailored intervention, essential for effectively managing the disease's progression. Integrating advanced technology with comprehensive clinical data represents a significant step forward in Parkinson's disease management, promising personalized care and improved outcomes for patients by addressing their unique needs and challenges. Furthermore, the integration of voice analysis adds a non-invasive dimension to Parkinson's diagnosis, potentially improving accessibility to screening methods. This approach holds promise for reaching underserved populations who may face barriers to traditional diagnostic procedures. By enhancing early detection and intervention, it offers the possibility of mitigating the disease's impact and improving overall patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of Adder Architectures: A Comparative Study Across Various Bit Lengths
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper delves into the application of Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) in both the design and enhancement of adders, pivotal components within digital systems. Five widely used adder architectures - Ripple Carry Adder, Carry Skip Adder, Carry Select Adder, Carry Look Ahead Adder, and Kogge Stone Adder - undergo rigorous evaluation. Leveraging the robust capabilities of Xilinx Vivado software, a comprehensive assessment of adder performance metrics, including delay, power consumption, temperature, and area utilization, is conducted across varying bit lengths (4bit to 32bit). Furthermore, practical implementation using the Basys 3 Xilinx Artix-7TM FPGA Board is executed. This meticulous analysis facilitates the identification of the most efficient adder architecture tailored to diverse bit lengths, thereby significantly enhancing the functionality and performance of digital systems across various applications.

articleTitle: Pigpen Cipher 9-Grid Characters Classification Using Enhanced CNN Deep Learning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In cryptography, breaking coded messages dates back many years. It often involves the use of various encoding techniques to obscure information. One such method is the Pigpen cipher, which substitutes letters with symbols from a grid layout. This study employs quad research grid characters with nine Pigpen ciphers to classify characters using EnhancedCNN deep learning techniques. For the most vulnerable in society, social safety nets are essential and decoding encrypted information can help improve the security of these systems from within. Pigpen character classification based on a structural model proposed by EnhancedCNN parallelizes training networks, which will help create an active environment among 27 classes of people in the modern field of social security. A total of 75,600 images was used in training and to validate the model, driving home the point that society needs to invest in advanced technology such as data analysis techniques responsible for better social outcomes. Finally, after five training sessions and an effective batch size of 27, iteration was completed. Continual refinement of protective systems for the vulnerable. Testing indicated that the proposed EnhancedCNN model performed particularly well, with an accuracy rate of 98%. Moreover, new technology in the context of social security frameworks is illustrated by our findings. This can then have a wide variety of potential applications, including automatic decryption of ancient pigpen characters on documents, cryptanalysis and data extraction journalism. All of these require government or social support within which technology innovation development plays a central role. The results from this study will improve pattern recognition methods involving deep learning, made possible with significant consequences for places where visualized data needs to be accurately classified safeguarding vulnerable communities and social protection systems.

articleTitle: Sentiment-Driven Predictive Models for Nifty 50 Stock Market Fluctuations: A Time Series Analysis Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper conducts a thorough semantic analysis of NIFTY-50 stock data, aiming to unravel the intricate dynamics of the Indian stock market. Employing a versatile blend of analytical and machine learning techniques, we delve into the historical performance of individual constituents of the NIFTY-50, seeking valuable insights into trends, patterns, and behavior. Special emphasis is placed on sentiment analysis, recognizing the crucial role of news, external factors, and market sentiment in influencing stock price movements. The utilization of time series forecasting techniques is a key aspect of our investigation, as these methods prove essential in financial analysis for accurate stock price predictions. This study underscores the significance of such techniques and their applicability to investors, financial analysts, and market participants. In essence, this paper serves as a valuable resource for anyone interested in navigating the complexities of the stock market. Our goal is to facilitate well-informed investment decisions and provide a foundation for further exploration in stock market analysis by incorporating a diverse range of techniques and approaches..

articleTitle: An Extensive Analyis of AI - Generative Art Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Recent developments in machine learning have significantly improved artificial intelligence (AI), which has led to the emergence of a growing trends. The fascinating area of AI and art has arisen within this wave of advancement, where the delicate balance between human creativity and AI capabilities is explored. Even though a lot of exciting projects have come to fruition at this point, the fundamental appreciation and comprehension of the inherent beauty of art still primarily constitute a component of human sensibility. The key ideas and findings made by academics in the field of AI art are examined in this paper. Although Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are widely used, a number of cutting-edge methods such as DALL E, DALL E-2, stable diffusion, multi-diffusion, DIFF EDIT, Midjourney and Mirror GAN have been introduced by the field's ongoing evolution. This variety of approaches demonstrates the range of image generation techniques available, making it difficult to choose the best strategy, especially when it comes to text-to-image synthesis. The paper explains the different methods used in these approaches, concentrating specifically on four core approaches: GANs, DALL E, Midjourney and Stable diffusion. It explains the basic ideas behind these methods and tell us about how they work. In addition, the paper includes a section on literature review which carefully examines the methods, results, and constraints of models developed by eight scholars in this field. This study underscores the potential for transformation within the art world and kindles a growing interest in the field of art by putting light on these techniques. The conclusion delves into captivating real-world applications of this theme, highlighting the considerable impact on contemporary art.

articleTitle: Fruitful Fusion: CNN-Random Forest Synergy in Banana Ripeness Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research paper introduces a new methodology for detecting the maturity of bananas by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Random Forest. The objective is to tackle the pressing need for automated evaluation of fruit quality in the field of agriculture. The experimental configuration included the use of Windows 11 as the operating system, an i5 processor as the central processing unit, and the Colab platform, which together facilitated efficient testing. The model had a notable overall accuracy rate of 86.97%, indicating its strong categorization skills. Additionally, the F1 score, which is calculated as the harmonic mean of accuracy and recall, exhibited an average value of 87.00, therefore emphasising the model's well-balanced performance. The precision scores showed a range of 81.97% to 91.37%, which signifies the level of accuracy in positive forecasts across various ripeness categories. The use of a hybrid strategy efficiently leveraged the feature extraction capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and the ensemble learning technique of Random Forest to achieve accurate and dependable classification. The findings indicate a significant development in the precise identification of fruit maturity, showcasing potential implications in enhancing harvest procedures and reducing post-harvest wastage. This research establishes a foundation for the development of enhanced and automated techniques for evaluating the quality of fruits, hence offering potential advantages to the agriculture sector.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Analysis of Birch Leafminer Disease: Varying Severity Five Class Ensemble Twin CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research explores a cutting-edge method in the area of agricultural disease control. The method relies on an ensemble model built around Twin Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) architecture. As part of an evaluation task, a dataset was compiled for over 90 thousand high-resolution images. It includes diseases variously manifested under different environmental conditions. The ensemble model performed extremely well, with an overall accuracy of 97.05<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> The model's accuracy in disease classification concerning evaluation metrics such as precision, recall and F1-score was independently verified. A confusion matrix was used to analyze the model, exposing its strong points and weaknesses. High-accuracy models could prevent early outbreaks of the disease, reducing crop loss and increasing productivity. The model will be refined in future versions by cleaning up specific misclassification patterns in that confusion matrix. This iterative purification process aims to strengthen the model's effectiveness, further reinforcing its key role in promoting precision agriculture practice.

articleTitle: Fake Logo Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Logo authentication is crucial in various domains to ensure the integrity and trustworthiness of visual brand representations. This project introduces a sophisticated Fake Logo Detection system leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to ascertain the legitimacy of provided logos by conducting a thorough analysis of key features, visual attributes, and patterns. In the contemporary landscape, logos play a pivotal role in defining a company's identity, and the proliferation of counterfeit logos poses a substantial threat to brand credibility. The innovative CNN-based methodology exploits its inherent capability to autonomously extract intricate features and patterns from logo images, facilitating a robust differentiation between authentic and manipulated logos. The model undergoes comprehensive training on a diverse dataset that spans a wide spectrum of logos, ensuring its adaptability to various visual styles. Through a meticulous examination of features, visual characteristics, and patterns, our system contributes to a nuanced comprehension of logo authenticity. Empirical results underscore the effectiveness of the proposed approach in accurately discerning real and fake logos, thus providing a valuable tool for safeguarding brands in the digital domain.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation and Hyperparameter Tuning Boost Food Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Food image classification has garnered significant interest in health and medical domains due to its potential for accurate calorie calculation and the development of sophisticated nutrition monitoring systems. Specifically, the study emphasizes the utilization of SqueezeNet, MobileNet, CNN, and NASNet architectures in the task of classifying food images. Among these architectures, SqueezeNet stands out for its lightweight construction, making it a practical and appealing choice for food classification tasks. Despite its simplicity, SqueezeNet demonstrates impressive performance in categorizing food images. Similarly, MobileNet achieves remarkable accuracy in food image categorization, even with fewer parameters, owing to its efficient depthwise separable convolutions. The traditional CNN architecture also contributes to the study, providing a baseline for comparison with more specialized models. Additionally, NASNet, with its sophisticated architecture discovered through neural architecture search techniques, showcases its ability to extract complex features from food photographs. In the comparison between these architectures, SqueezeNet and MobileNet show competitive performance, outperforming traditional CNN and NASNet in the field of classifying food images. Moreover, the systems demonstrate proficiency in associating food item names with their corresponding visuals, facilitating approximate recognition of these products. By exploring the intricacies of automated food classification and leveraging deep learning models such as SqueezeNet, MobileNet, CNN, and NASNet, this study makes a significant contribution to the field. It opens doors to more precise and efficient applications in health and medical sectors, offering promising avenues for enhanced nutrition monitoring and calorie calculation systems.

articleTitle: Synthetic to Real-World: Insights on Microservices-Based Application Benchmarks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This paper focuses on implementing a realis-tic microservice-based application from DeathStarBench into μBench and the challenges associated with it. Unlike traditional monolithic applications, microservice apps comprise multiple smaller components that are comparatively complex. This makes benchmarking essential. Benchmarking is a process of evaluating and comparing the performance of a system, such as efficiency, effectiveness, quality, or cost, to assess how well a particular entity is performing compared to a reference point, often referred to as a benchmark. A benchmarking tool that employs near real-world applications, extending beyond the capabilities of the existing tools. The inclusion of configuring the microservices from scratch allows for a more comprehensive understanding of application performance, which is crucial for today's complex cloud-based applications [1]. Through synthetic benchmarking, μBench simulates real-world conditions, offering a more com-plete performance analysis. In this paper, we expand the tool μBench to effectively demonstrate its proficiency in deploying and benchmarking a diverse range of microservice applications by mimicking real-world applications like DeathStarBench and Teastore, analysing the performance and resource utilisation through various tools like Kiali, Prometheus and Jaeger.

articleTitle: Heart Stroke Prediction Using Machine Learning and Explainable AI Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Heart stroke is a critical worldwide medical problem that requires early and accurate prediction in order to provide proper treatment. Recent advancements in machine learning, utilizing models such as XGBoost, Decision Tree, KNN, SVC, and Random Forest, have demonstrated promise in predicting patients at risks from medical data like Age, BMI, Glucose Levels, Hypertension, Heart disease etc., The aim is to evaluate the effectiveness of these machine learning models in predicting people at risk. Metrics like recall, precision, accuracy, and F1-score are examined to assess how well these models perform in predicting the risk of heart strokes. In addition, the research will look at the primary features of medical data that influence model predictions, using Explainable AI techniques such as SHAP. The overall objective is to provide effective and exact approaches for early detection of heart stroke risks, allowing patients to receive timely and important medical care when it is most needed.

articleTitle: A Holistic Framework for Building Type Classification Using CNN and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This study has developed a cutting-edge CNN model to classify various building types. This model has the potential to revolutionize urban management and planning. The results presented in Table 1 reveal the model's impressive performance in categorizing buildings into three classes: Apartment, Industrial, and Other. Its precision, recall, and F1-score values consistently exceed 95%, indicating its exceptional ability to recognize and distinguish intricate patterns in building characteristics for accurate classification. This model offers a powerful tool for urban planning and management, significantly enhancing decision-making in various urban development aspects. The Macro Average, Weighted Average, and Micro Average values of the model demonstrate its consistency and adaptability. The model performs well with datasets of different compositions due to support proportions aligning with the number of instances in each class. The model's overall accuracy of 97% indicates its ability to make correct predictions. This makes it useful in urban resource allocation and disaster response planning. The Weighted Average values also highlight the model's ability to handle imbalances in class sizes, making it more reliable for practical applications. The Micro Average approach provides an overall measure with a focus on the model's overall performance. It's a powerful tool for classifying building types. The CNN-based approach is a big step forward in making building-type classification automatic. It is a highly accurate and efficient solution that can be used by cities and others to manage resources, plan for emergencies, and make decisions. The model's high performance across different measurements shows that it is a reliable tool for dealing with the complexity of categorizing different urban areas.

articleTitle: Unraveling Deception: Pioneering Machine Learning Solutions for Authenticating News in Evolving Social Media Landscapes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's digital age, social media's pervasive influence has led to rapid information dissemination, often accompanied by the spread of fake news. While news websites provide trustworthy sources, social media platforms remain the preferred source for many. However, verifying headlines and posts shared on these platforms is crucial to prevent the spread of false information. Human validation is impractical, necessitating the use of machine learning classifiers. The Social Media Fake News Detection project aims to develop a reliable system using natural language processing and machine learning techniques. By analyzing textual and multimedia data, including sentiment analysis and feature engineering, the project aims to empower users to differentiate between credible information and false narratives, thus mitigating the societal impact of fake news.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Advanced Temperature Control System for Maglev Transport
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This research embarks on the development of an intelligent climate control system tailored specifically for advanced energy-efficient maglev pods. By amalgamating state-of-the-art IoT technology with an extensive suite of sensors encompassing temperature, air quality, humidity, and occupancy detection, this project endeavours to redefine the standards of onboard environmental management. Central to the system's architecture is a proprietary control algorithm, meticulously engineered to harness the wealth of sensor data and optimize the pod's compressor duty cycle. Through iterative adjustments based on real-time environmental variables, the system orchestrates an environment conducive to optimal passenger comfort and well-being while simultaneously minimizing energy consumption. The dynamic modulation of the compressor's duty cycle represents a pivotal advancement in energy efficiency. By precisely synchronizing compressor operation with fluctuating environmental conditions, the system eliminates unnecessary energy expenditure during periods of low demand, thereby mitigating wastage and enhancing overall efficiency. Looking forward, this project holds immense promise for scalability and adaptability across diverse transportation contexts. Its ability to seamlessly integrate with existing infrastructure and adapt to evolving operational requirements positions it as a transformative force in the realm of urban mobility solutions. In summary, this research not only signifies a significant leap forward in transportation technology but also underscores the pivotal role of innovation in fostering sustainability and resilience. Through the convergence of cutting-edge technology and human ingenuity, the future beckons with boundless opportunities to realize the transformative potential of intelligent climate control systems in shaping a more efficient and sustainable world.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Underwater Wireless Communication System Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Establishing dependable communication in underwater situations is extremely difficult because of things like noise, multipath propagation, and signal attenuation. In order to properly solve these issues, a comprehensive underwater wireless communication system is introduced. To improve dependability and reduce errors, the system starts by encoding the incoming data bits using channel coding algorithms. For effective transmission, the modulated signal is subsequently converted using Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) modulation. An Inverse Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT) and cyclic prefix addition are used to counteract the effects of underwater channel distortion and lessen inter-symbol interference. The quality of the broadcast signal is lowered by a number of impairments, including as fading and additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN). An adaptive equalizer is used to dynamically modify the receiver characteristics in order to counteract these effects and enhance signal recovery. To precisely retrieve the sent information, the received signal is additionally subjected to the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). The system's performance is evaluated by comparing the output bits with the original input following demodulation and decoding. The bit error rate, throughput, and overall dependability of the suggested system are assessed in order to determine its efficacy through simulation and analysis. All things considered, the suggested underwater wireless communication system shows potential for reliable and effective data transfer in difficult underwater settings.

articleTitle: A Novel Dielectric Modulated Double Gate Charge-Trapping MOSFET: Ferroelectric Gate Stack and Gaussian Doped Substrate Integration for Enhanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: His paper investigates the operational characteristics and performance metrics of a novel double gate charge-trapping metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (DG-MOSFET) that incorporates a ferroelectric gate stack, a Gaussian-doped multilayered substrate, and a buried oxide layer. The study utilizes Silvaco TCAD(Technology Computer-Aided Design) Atlas for device simulation and analysis. A comprehensive comparison between the proposed DG-MOSFET, a conventional DG-MOSFET, and other variations, has been presented. Through detailed simulations and analysis, the paper evaluates key parameters including threshold voltage, subthreshold swing, drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL), on/off current ratio, and transconductance. Different modifications were carried out and their implications were compared to study device performance. Results indicate that the proposed DG-MOSFET exhibits superior performance characteristics compared to both reference devices, showcasing enhanced carrier mobility, reduced leakage current, and improved subthreshold behavior. Furthermore, the Gaussian doped multilayered substrate contributes to mitigating short-channel effects, enhancing overall device scalability and reliability. his paper investigates the operational characteristics and performance metrics of a novel double gate charge-trapping metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (DG-MOSFET) that incorporates a ferroelectric gate stack, a Gaussian-doped multilayered substrate, and a buried oxide layer. articleTitle: FedAnom: Strengthening Cloud Network Security with Federated Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Anomaly detection forms the cornerstone of ensuring the security of cloud networks. In this paper, we present an innovative approach aimed at enhancing anomaly detection in cloud networks by harnessing federated learning coupled with differential privacy. Building upon the foundation of autoencoder-based anomaly detection, our method integrates ensemble methods to amplify accuracy. Furthermore, our model incorporates adversarial robustness techniques to fortify resilience against potential attacks. Dynamic thresholding is employed to ensure adaptability to the evolving threat landscape. Through extensive evaluations conducted on diverse datasets, our approach showcases scalability, efficiency, and real-world effectiveness. Specifically, our model achieves a notable enhancement in accuracy and a substantial reduction in false positives compared to existing methods, signifying significant strides in bolstering cloud network security. By offering practical solutions for strengthening anomaly detection capabilities within cloud environments, our research contributes to the augmentation of cybersecurity infrastructure. This novel approach, empowered by federated learning with differential privacy, holds promise for effectively navigating the dynamic threat landscape and safeguarding cloud-based systems against malicious activities.

articleTitle: Leukemia Subtype Classification via Gene Expression Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This project aims to improve patient care and treatment outcomes by using gene expression data to reliably diagnose acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL). To create trustworthy classification models, six machine learning (ML) techniques were used: Gaussian Naive Bayes (NB), Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), K Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Multi-Layer Perceptron(MLP), and Logistic Regression. The experiment's outcomes show that the algorithms were successful; 91% accuracy rates were achieved by both logistic regression and MLP, while the other approaches produced results that were competitive. Good findings for the ROC curve analysis area under the curve (ROCAUC) demonstrated the models' ability to distinguish between different forms of cancer. These results demonstrate the application of ML algorithms in oncology.

articleTitle: Epicardial Fat Segmentation Using Pyramid Neural Network: An Automated Approach for Cardiovascular Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This work focuses on the automated segmentation of epicardial fat using a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) and subsequent classification of severity levels utilizing Support Vector Machine (SVM) models. Epicardial fat, an important biomarker for cardiovascular diseases, requires accurate segmentation for quantitative analysis. The proposed FPN architecture leverages multi-scale features for precise delineation of epicardial fat boundaries from cardiac imaging data. Following segmentation, an SVM-based classification system is implemented to categorize the segmented fat regions into low, high, and moderate severity classes based on specific features extracted from the segmented regions. The SVM models are trained and validated on labeled datasets with varying severity levels to ensure robustness and accuracy in classifying the severity of epicardial fat. The proposed framework exhibits promising results in both segmentation and severity classification, providing a reliable tool for automated assessment and risk stratification in cardiovascular disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System Based On Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques *
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The face is a critical perspective in predicting human feelings and moods. More frequently than not human senti-ments are extricated with the utilization of the camera. Various applications are being made based on the location of human sentiments. A few applications of feeling revelation are trade notice suggestion, e-learning, mental clutter, sadness disclosure, criminal conduct discovery, etc. This paper presents a novel real-time emotion-based movie recommendation system that combines computer vision, deep learning, and image processing strategies. The system coordinating OpenCV near DeepFace for effective emotion examination utilizing webcam input, giving clients personalized movie recommendations based on their recognized enthusiastic states. The system commences by using OpenCV to capture real-time webcam feeds and utilizes a Haar-Cascade classifier for facial discovery. The recognized faces are analyzed for prevailing feelings utilizing the DeepFace library, empowering exact feeling distinguishing proof. Within the recommendation stage, the system joins content-based filtering by processing a movie dataset utilizing TF-IDF. Genres and plot keywords serve as features for building the TF-IDF matrix. Cosine similarities between the user's emotion vector and relevant movie genres are then calculated, coming about in a list of personalized movie rec-ommendations. Index Terms-FER, OpenCV, DeepFace, Haar-Cascade Algorithm, Content-Based Filtering, TF-IDF

articleTitle: Hybrid Model of Data Segregation for Enhanced OS Modularity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the data-driven environment we live in today, where disorganization may inhibit productivity and workflow efficiency, effective digital file management is essential. This study and its suggested model present a novel mechanism concept a Python-based system created to address the widespread problem of disarrayed digital file systems. The “Group by” function of file managers available on many OSs currently does not address this problem because it groups files solely on the basis of one type of extension. Reducing the time & effort needed for manual organization, the suggested methodology automates the sorting & categorizing of files, including photos, documents, music, videos, archives, books, & code. Through its ability to optimize digital workflows & improve user experiences, this technology makes file management easier. To better understand the scalability, performance of the designed module, we conducted extensive performance testing on different devices & architectures. The results of this testing provided insightful information that can be applied to improve digital file organization in the real world. Additionally, the information revealed factors & relationships related to the organizing & sorting at the hardware level.

articleTitle: Visio-Voice Transforming Images into Sound for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The integration of deep learning and computer vision has led to groundbreaking innovations, notably in Image-to-Audio technologies. This transformative paradigm aims to provide comprehensible audio descriptions for visual content, offering increased independence and inclusivity for individuals with visual impairments. Rooted in intricate computational methodologies, this approach seamlessly translates visual data into auditory representations. The paper explores the technical aspects of Image-to-Audio conversion, emphasizing its potential applications in digital media, education, and everyday environments. Technology is seen as a societal catalyst, empowering individuals with visual impairments and fostering newfound self-sufficiency and autonomy.

articleTitle: The Software Verification Tool Examines the Research and Application of Intelligent Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in the research and application of inspection intelligent robots, a research and application scheme of intelligent robots based on software verification tools is proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the accounting and positioning theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the research and application scheme of intelligent robots is constructed by using software verification tools. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of research and application accuracy of intelligent robots, and processing time of influencing factors, which has obvious advantages. The research and application of intelligent robots plays an extremely important role in the intelligent era, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation in the intelligent era. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving the research and simulation problems of robots, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research and application scheme of intelligent robot based on software verification tools to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through the accounting positioning theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses software verification tools to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on software verification tools can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the research and application of inspection intelligent robots.

articleTitle: Enhanced Diagnosis Approach of Lung Cancer with Leveraged Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The complex structure of lung cancer makes early detection and diagnosis difficult, even though they are critical for better patient outcomes. In this study, we delve into the realm of deep learning to enhance the diagnosis of lung cancer, leveraging CT scan images. We intend to determine the best effective strategy for early cancer detection by meticulously pre-processing the dataset and comparing multiple deep learning models, such as ResNet152V2, Inception V3, ANN, and FNN. The practical application and comparative study of these models are provided by our research, which adds to the field by illuminating their diagnostic accuracy and performance measures including Accuracy, Precision, Sensitivity, Specificity, and Area under the ROC curve. We also delve into the possibilities for building strong clinical decision support systems for early cancer detection, as well as the role of deep learning in medical imaging. While our study presents some interesting findings and discusses different aspects of technology in the realm of programming testing, it is acknowledged that further improvements are needed. Specifically, enhancing the presentation quality, providing more detailed explanations of the proposed algorithms, and incorporating substantial results or insights are recommended for future iterations of this research. Through continual refinement and exploration, we aim to contribute to the ongoing advancements in deep learning-based cancer detection, ultimately striving for improved patient outcomes and enhanced clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Mobile Banking Intention in a High-Risk Situation: Exploring the Impact of Bank Reputation and Security Perception
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In light of an increase in fraudulent activity targeting mobile banking users, it is more important than ever to understand the elements driving consumers' intent to use these platforms. This quantitative study explores the subtle interplay of bank reputation, social impact, and security perception using a survey approach and Structural Equation Modeling with Partial Least Squares (SEM PLS). This inquiry takes place when a scam-prone society arises marked by a surge of scam-related news and increased security concerns. The goal of this study is to provide useful insights to financial institutions and policymakers in order to strengthen the security and trustworthiness of mobile banking systems. The study thoroughly explores the correlations between these major variables with a sample size of 140 participants. The findings highlight the importance of bank reputation in influencing consumers' intentions to use mobile banking services. Furthermore, in the face of growing scam attempts, security perception and social influence appear as significant mediating elements in changing users' attitudes and intentionsentions, particularly in the face of increased scam attempts. These insights have significant implications for strategies aimed at enhancing user adoption and security in mobile banking platforms.

articleTitle: Battery Range Estimation in Electric Vehicles Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Greenhouse gas emission has been a prominent issue leading to global warming. One of the reasons is the use of motor vehicles fueled by oil and natural gas. These vehicles burn the oil and gases to power their engines that leads to the release of several gases into the Earth's atmosphere. One of these gases is CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, a greenhouse gas contributing to global warming. Electric vehicles popularly known as EVs becoming a major solution to this issue. However, they face few practical issues like the long wait time to recharge the batteries. One of the issues is the estimation of remaining distance coverage with the available battery power. This is crucial as it helps the users to plan their next recharge efficiently. This paper presents the application of machine learning in estimating the travel distance that can be covered with the available battery power remaining. This paper explored several state-of-the-art machine learning models and propose LSTM as the suitable technique to accurately estimate the distance that can be covered with the remaining battery power. The models were evaluated using an open-source dataset taken from Kaggle. The proposed model achieved a mean <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> score of 0.84 and demonstrated the potential of LSTM technique for this problem. The findings of this work is time relevant as the demand for EVs are increasing everyday.

articleTitle: Exploring the Enabling Technologies of Contactless Fingerprint Reader
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The most common way to identify a person is by using their fingerprint, which involves comparing two fingerprints: one that has been saved as having been previously captured and one that is now being scanned by a sensor. The human fingerprint is one of a kind; it can withstand the system for an individual's entire lifetime; and it is recognized in the field of forensic inquiry. In older systems, the finger is allowed to make as many contacts with the sensor as necessary throughout the scanning process, which might cause the sensor's quality to decline. The quality of fingerprint images may be improved using a variety of approaches, each of which has been presented by a different researcher. This study examines a variety of fingerprint identification methods, including Minutia-based mapping and the CNN algorithm, both of which make use of deep learning.

articleTitle: Anylogic and Python-Based Gunshot Detection System Using CNN and Trilateration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Gunshot detection has been applied in fields such as defense and forensic sciences. This plays a very critical role in law enforcement and public safety. Detecting a gunshot begins with automatic detection of the presence of an audio event. These rare events can be analyzed and prevented by using a system that detects the audio and location of gunshots. The success of this system relies ultimately on its accuracy. In this paper, audio data has been collected and a machine learning(ML) model using a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) has been trained that classifies the audio and detects a gunshot acoustic. The prediction of the gunshot location has been implemented using the trilateration method with the use of AI agents as sensors. The model has been trained in Python programming language. This simulation has been implemented in the Java programming language with AnyLogic software as the user interface.

articleTitle: Construction of Corpus Segmentation Feature Extraction Model and Its Influence on Literary Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Platform This study proposes the construction of a feature extraction model for word segmentation based on large-scale corpus, which mainly includes three parts: a parser based on hierarchical long sentence decomposition and support vector machine basic noun recognition, a literary translation sub engine based on instance matching, and a statistical literary translation subengine based on chunks. This language and literature translation model synthesizes the advantages of various literary translation models, and maximizes the accuracy and recall rate of literary translation based on corp-based feature extraction model. The experimental results show that the system has ideal indexes, especially high processing efficiency.

articleTitle: An Optimized Blockchain Model for Secure and Efficient Data Management in Internet of Things*
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed the way we collect, process, and store data. However, the security, scalability, and transparency challenges that come with managing IoT data have become a major concern. In this research, we proposed an optimized blockchain model for secure and efficient data management in IoT environments. The proposed model uses a combination of sharding and pruning techniques to improve scalability, off-chain storage to reduce the storage overhead of the blockchain, and a custom consensus mechanism designed for IoT environments. The evaluation results showed that the proposed model can handle large numbers of IoT devices and data volumes, with good scalability, user experience, and integration capabilities with other systems. While the proposed model is an improvement over existing solutions in terms of security, transparency, and scalability, more research is needed to improve the model's functionality, validate its performance in real-world scenarios, and enhance its security and privacy mechanisms. Our proposed blockchain model has the potential to enhance data management in IoT environments, and could pave the way for a more secure and efficient data management future.

articleTitle: Synergizing CNN and Random Forest for Accurate Cattle Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The current research focuses on the essential undertaking of multiclass classification in the context of diagnosing skin disorders in cattle. It aims to provide a thorough assessment of a complete model. The introduction underscores the need of rapid illness diagnosis in veterinary practises. The aim of this study is to construct a robust model that can successfully identify a wide range of skin diseases in cattle with high accuracy. The precision values, which range from 88.12% to 97.57%, serve as indicators of the model's proficiency in accurately predicting distinct classes. The model's ability to make accurate predictions across several categories is highlighted by its overall accuracy of 91.56%, indicating a high level of competency and reliability. The research use a comprehensive dataset and incorporates sophisticated machine learning methods to improve the detection of diseases. The attainment of a high level of precision and accuracy plays a significant role in enhancing the dependability of the model in real-world scenarios, hence enabling timely intervention and treatment. The results indicate that the model that was created has potential for effective use in actual situations, offering a significant resource for veterinarians in the management and treatment of skin disorders in cattle. This research makes a valuable contribution to the continuous endeavours in using machine learning techniques to enhance cattle health and emphasises the potential for further breakthroughs in disease identification strategies.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Programmable Clock Management Unit Using Clock Dividers and Clock Gating using 45nm technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The Design and analysis of a Programmable Clock Management Unit Using Clock Dividers and Clock Gating employing a Cadence project aimed at adapting clock management by addressing critical problems associated with clock power consumption and energy efficiency within the electronic devices. It involves the generation of adaptable Clock Management Unit (CMU) that efficiently generates and distributes clock signals to various components. This work includes power management, examining and solving the challenges of managing different parts of the clock in System-on-chip (Soc) setups. We aim in designing a CMU capable of dynamically adjusting clock frequencies and implementing effective clock gating techniques. The goal of this work is to efficiently cut down the amount of power used when the system is active. Additionally, this work seeks to improve adaptability by utilizing clock dividers and clock gating through the Cadence tool. This approach allows for a more flexible and efficient control of clock signals modified to the specific needs of different components. Finally, this work is designed in the intension of making electronic circuits use less energy and work better, helping to advance modern technology.

articleTitle: Recognition of Indian Sign Languageusing SURF, BoW & CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Communication is indispensable for living in this world. However, Deaf and Mute people struggle while communicating with others. Sign Language (SL) allows such people to communicate with other members of society. Hand gesture-based communication has applications in different fields, including auto UIs, wellbeing, clinical frameworks, emergency, calamity help, and human-robot/PC collaboration. To recognize ISL alphabets and integers and convert them into text, we create an ISL dataset with 35 classes, each with 1200 images. In this paper, the Canny Edge Detection Technique is used to pre- process these images, Speeded Up Robust Feature (SURF) is used for feature extraction, and K-means clustering is used to cluster these features. Visual word vectors and classification are obtained using the Bag of Visual Words and CNN, respectively. The proposed system's reliability is assessed using different machine learning classifiers like KNN, SVM, & LogisticRegression for the same dataset which provides an average accuracy of 99.3% in the case of CNN, which is significantly higher than numerous earlier approaches.

articleTitle: Enhancing Precision in Papaya Crop Health Management: A CNN-Based Approach for Early Disease Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: This study describes a unique Convolutional neural network, or CNN, topology that consists of three levels of convolution, three maximally pooled layers, and two fully linked layers. It is designed to accurately predict six different illnesses affecting papaya branches, including Papaya Ringspot. Virus, Papaya Mosaic Virus, Powdery Mildew, Papaya Bunchy Top Disease, Anthracnose, and Black Spot Disease. The work addresses the critical need for improved identification of diseases in papaya growing within the context of precision agriculture. It entails creating a diversified dataset with photos of both healthy and sick papaya leaves. The precisely designed CNN architecture retrieves intricate information from these photos, allowing for a categorization of various illness types. Attributes are finely adjusted using intensive training and validation techniques to ensure the model's resilience in disease prediction. The accuracy, recall, and F1-score are evaluation metrics that quantify the algorithm's performance across illness categories. The findings illustrate the model's ability to distinguish between the defined papaya leaf diseases. The expected goals include developing an efficient instrument for disease early detection and control in papaya growing, thereby helping promote precision farming that is efficient and sustainable crop health management.

Author Keywords: Papaya Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) Leaf Diseases

articleTitle: Weighted Convolutional Neural Network for Detection of Microaneurysms and Exudates in Retinal Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: One frequent diabetes consequence that affects the eyes is diabetic retinopathy. It is the world's leading contributor to blindness. Over 93 million diabetics, according to the World Health Organization (WHO), have diabetic retinopathy in some form. An estimated 7.7 million Americans, or 40% of all diabetics, are thought to be affected with diabetic retinopathy. With age and the duration of diabetes, the prevalence of diabetic retinopathy rises. Most people with type 2 diabetes who have had the disease for more than 10 years and nearly all people with type 1 diabetes who have had it for more than 20 years are predicted to acquire diabetic retinopathy at some point in their lives. Here, Weighted Convolutional Neural Networks (WCNNs), a form of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), are used to detect Microaneurysm and Exudates by using weights in the convolutional operation to give more priority to particular features or regions in the input data. Early signs of diabetic retinopathy include microaneurysm and exudates. It has been noted that WNN's results outperform those of standard CNN, where sensitivity increase from 87.02(CNN) to 88.51(WNN). Similarly, Specificity, Precision and Accuracy increases from 79.49, 91.09 and 84.81 to 82.56, 92.44 and 86.77 respectively. For early detection of diabetic retinopathy grading is used and related results are also compared.

articleTitle: Deep Optimized Smart Healthcare System for the Detection of Diabetes and Cardiovascular Ailments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (loT) is a valuable tool in the field of smart healthcare for diagnosing a wide range of illnesses in Healthcare Systems. It is noticed that the traditional diagnostic techniques consume much more time and may result in inaccuracies making the ailment identification faulty. This necessitates a smart using the concept of Deep Learning (DL). As a motivation, the concept of blending ailment prediction with DL for precise prediction is attempted in this study. In this work, an innovative structure for detecting the occurrence of diabetes and cardiac ailment from the medical database is developed and it is referred to as the Deep Optimized Smart Healthcare system. In this study, an advanced optimization technique, the Boosted Binary Harris Hawks (BB-HH) is used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset to improve the performance of the classifier implemented. Subsequently, the traits of the BB-HH optimization technique are used for the development of the Gated Recurrent Deep Convolutional Network (GDRCNet) technique for performing the classification of the ailment. Furthermore, the loss function of the Gated Recurrent Deep Convolutional Network is estimated with the help of the Krill Herd Optimization technique to enhance the accuracy of the developed classifier. The performance evaluation and validation of the proposed Deep Optimized Smart Healthcare System is carried out using diabetes and cardiovascular ailment datasets from PIMA.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Mold Material Defects Using CNN-Random Forest Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In the abstract, The effective identification and categorization of mould material faults are critical for ensuring the quality and dependability of substances in a variety of industrial settings. This paper, it provides a unique approach to recognizing mould defects that utilizes a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and a Random Forest algorithm. Our technique is tested across an array of defect classifications, including pitting, blistering, cracking, inclusions, and flashing. The precision, recall, or FI-Score metrics demonstrate the framework's ability to reliably detect each fault type. Notably, our model has a macro-average F1 score of 82.95%, indicating strong performance throughout all classes. The weighted mean FI-Score of 83.06% corrects for class imbalances, illustrating the model's capacity to manage varied fault incidences. The previously micro-average F1 score of 83.07% measures the model's overall performance across the dataset. The Support Percentage metrics provide an understanding of the range of defect categories in the dataset, while an overall precision of 93% demonstrates the model's ability to anticipate mould material flaws. This research advances manufacturing quality assurance procedures by providing a dependable solution for the timely identification and categorization of mould flaws, assuring the quality and dependability of final goods in a variety of sectors.

articleTitle: 2D Brain MRI Segmentation: U-Nets Versus Optimized DeepLab Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Brain tumors can cause a variety of psychiatric symptoms. Early detection of these tumors can significantly improve the chances of treating or preventing other diseases like Alzheimer's, dementia, multiple sclerosis, and bipolar disorder. Our paper proposes a novel method using semantic segmentation to detect brain tumors in MRI scans. We compare two DeepLab architectures (DeepLab V3 and DeepLabv3 with ResNet-101 backbone) against a baseline U-Net model, all trained and validated on a dataset of 3,929 brain MRI images. DeepLabv3 with ResNet-101 achieved the highest accuracy (Dice coefficient of 0.8746), outperforming both U-Net (0.7517) and DeepLabV3 (0.8177). DeepLabv3 with ResNet-101 also achieved the highest training accuracy (Dice coefficient of 0.9605) and validation accuracy(0.8579). This research demonstrates that DeepLabv3 with ResNet-101 backbone surpasses the pre-existing methods for brain tumor detection in MRI scans.

articleTitle: Peer link: Personalized Collaborative Partner Recommendation through Natural Language Processing and Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: In today's globalized landscape, collaborative partnerships are indispensable drivers of innovation and growth across diverse sectors. However, identifying suitable collaborative partners can be a challenging task for people, particularly in large educational institutions, online learning platforms, or in the workplace. Also, when seeking a collaborative partner for participation in an event, it is imperative to identify an individual who not only comprehends one's perspective but also aligns with their approach and is prepared to engage in effective collaboration. This study proposes a Collaborative Partner Recommendation System (CPRS) designed to facilitate the formation of effective study groups and teams to participate in events. The CPRS employs a multi-faceted approach, considering factors such as learning preferences, performance, and personal criteria to match compatible collaborative partners. This platform facilitates global communication among students, enabling them to collaborate on projects or engage in international hackathons regardless of their geographical locations. Additionally, the CPRS integrates Natural Language Processing (NLP) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithms to enhance partner recommendations. NLP techniques are utilized to extract key skill sets from resumes, enabling a comprehensive understanding of users' backgrounds, interests, and goals. Subsequently, KNN is employed to identify the nearest neighbours within the feature space, further refining recommendation accuracy. This integrated approach streamlines the process of identifying suitable collaborative partners, facilitating effective collaboration and maximizing the potential of partnerships.

articleTitle: Implementation of MIPS RISC Processor with Flexible 5-Stage Pipelining and Dynamic Thermal Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The MIPS RISC processor is characterized by its simplicity, pipelined architecture, register-centric design, and a reduced set of instructions optimized for performance. This paper explores the implementation of MIPS RISC processor in mobile and embedded spaces, focusing on power efficiency and processing speed through a flexible 5-stage pipeline and dynamic thermal control. The processor incorporates flexible pipelining and dynamic thermal control mechanisms to balance power consumption and performance along with energy efficiency and processing speed. Simulations validate these features, and future prospects include expanding the instruction set and optimizing frequency scaling. The methodology involves Logisim for structural planning, simulation on EDA Play-ground and Cadence Xcelium 20.9. Simulations validate flexible pipelining and dynamic thermal control. Future prospects include expanding the instruction set, optimizing frequency scaling, and extending the design to 64-bit RISC architecture. In summary, this paper contributes to the ongoing pursuit of efficient and adaptable microprocessor designs in advanced computing systems, showcasing the significance of flexible pipelining and dynamic thermal control in achieving optimized energy-efficient performance.

articleTitle: A Pipeline Approach to Research Paper Recommendation System Integrating TF-IDF and KNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: The literature review is a critical analysis of existing research papers, systematically summarizing and evaluating relevant studies, books, and sources to offer a comprehensive overview and identify gaps in knowledge. It guides researchers in formulating questions and contributes to the existing body of knowledge. However, researchers often struggle to locate suitable articles, especially those with limited search expertise. Traditional recommendation methods sometimes don't work well in the ever-changing world of academic papers. It's tough to keep up with the newest research and find high quality papers that are less cited. Recognizing these limitations, the proposed research paper recommendation system stands out as an innovative solution to help researchers overcome difficulties. At its core, the system employs a sophisticated pipelined hybrid approach, combining content-based strategies with collaborative filtering techniques. This integration aims to overcome the shortcomings of conventional methods by providing a more robust recommendation mechanism. Content-based methods include TF-IDF with cosine similarity. Collaborative filtering includes Knn, seamlessly blending content-based insights into collaborative filtering results. The system's dataset is sourced from ArXiv, which has provided open access to scholarly articles for almost 30 years. Spanning various fields, this extensive repository, available through Kaggle, encompasses 1.7 million articles with features like titles, authors, categories, abstracts, and full text PDFs. It offers significant depth for efficient data extraction. By blending the strengths of arXiv dataset, content-based and collaborative filtering, the system achieves a synergy that not only captures the richness of individual methods but also harnesses their combined power to deliver recommendations that are both timely and comprehensive.

articleTitle: A Two-Speed,Radix-4, Parallel-Parallel Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Digital multiplication is an important task in various computer applications, and increasing its performance is essential to enhance performance and power consumption. This article presents a low-power modified booth multiplier(MBM) design scheme reducing energy consumption while maintaining efficiency. A modified booth algorithm is used to reduce partial production, and several low-power methods are included in the multiplier architecture. The proposed design incorporates optimized booth encoding, low-power arithmetic blocks and pipeline platforms to increase energy efficiency. Clock-gating is creatively used to disable passive components and selectively shuts off unused portions of the power-gating multiplier. Also, parallelism is required to increase speed, and supply voltage scaling is judicially applied to balance power reduction with reliable operation. Simulation results and comparisons with conventional multiplier architectures demonstrate the effectiveness of the low-power scheme. The results reveal a significant reduction in dynamic and static energy consumption, establishing the proposed modified booth theory as a viable alternative low-enrgy battery-powered device. This research is in line with the growing demand for energy-efficient design for modern computing systems that helps to maintain efficiency related to statistical units.

articleTitle: Handwritten to English: AI Manuscript Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Information Technology, Electronics and Intelligent Communication Systems (ICITEICS)
abstract: Addressing real-time translation and accessibility challenges in historical manuscripts written in the Devanagiri script, this research introduces an implementation of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) seamlessly integrated with intelligent agents.
